tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// dpal rdo rje gdan bzhi pa'i cho ga zab pa'i myu gu dkyil chog dang bcas pa bklags pas grub par bkod pa bzhugs so//

༄༅// 'phrog byed ral pa'i ri steng bcom ldan 'das// ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sprin gyis rtag 'khyud pas// bde ba'i rlan gyis rlon pa'i shugs drag po// rnal 'byor nam mkhar btud de sgrub thabs bri/ /dam tshig dang ldan pa'i sgrub pos rnal 'byor gyi yo byad tshang bas mdun du bdar/ bde ba'i stan la 'dug nas gdan bzhi bsgom par bya ste/ sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi dang rjes so// dang po ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnal 'byor nam mkha'i skur gsal bar gyur/ zhes bsam/ de nas/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du a dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mdzub mo la suṃ/ gung mo la kṣuṃ/ srin lag la yuṃ/ mthe'u chung la ham̐'u/ mthe bong la a las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon pa'i mthil du sa dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ mdzub mo la saṃmarayu/ gung mo la haṃmarayu/ srin lag la yaṃmarayu/ mthe'u chung la kṣaṃmarayu/ mthe bong la paṃ las padma 'dab ma lnga pa/ mgrin par hrīḥlas padma 'dab ma brgyad pa dmar po/ lce'i 'dab ma la ham̐'u las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ oṃ a dziḥhwā saṃ brta ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan te lhag ma brkyang ba ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gtug cing*/ spyi bor kṣuṃ/ mig gnyis la hūm̐/ rna ba gnyis dang sna la yuṃ/ lce la suṃ/ mgrin par saṃmarayu/ dpung pa gnyis la haṃmarayu/ snying gar yaṃmarayu/ lte bar kṣaṃmarayu/ dgod/ yang phyag rgya de nyid spyi bor gtug cing*/ oṃ badzra kā ya hoḥ mgrin par gtug cing*/ oṃ badzra wāka ྄āḥ snying gar gtug cing*/ oṃ badzra tsitta hūm̐/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas gung mo gnyis bsgreng ba rtse sprad/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes mchod yon gyi snod la lan gsum mam nyi shu rtsa gcig bzla/ g.yas rdo rje khu tshur bcings te mthe bong dang mdzub mo sbyar nas lhag ma gsum mthe'u chung nas rim pas brkyang la/

oṃ pra wa ra satka rā pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhes zhabs bsil gyi snod la bzla/ rdo rje khu tshur bcings te mdzub mo gnyis lcags sgrog ltar sbrel la/ oṃ saṃmarayu swā hā/ zhes bsang gtor gyi snod la bzla/ de nas rdo rje rtse mos bsang gtor gyi chu blangs nas mchod pa'i yan lag thams cad la gtor zhing*/ oṃ saṃ sho dha ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces lan nyi shu rtsa gcig brjod do// lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo brkyang mthe bong gnyis sbrel la ngang pa'i gshog pa lta bu phyir bzlog ste kha nang du bstan nas snying gar bzhag la/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lus thams cad la rdo rje'i go cha legs par bsam/ rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis brkyang rtse sprad de dang por sa la btsugs la de nas gyen du bskor zhing*/ hūm̐ zhes nga ro dang bcas pas/ 'og tu phur bu'i sa gzhi dang*/ steng du rdo rje'i drwa ba dang bcas pa'i gur phyogs mtshams thams cad du rdo rje'i ra ba/ rdo rje bsdams pa la gung mo gnyis brkyang ste/ rtse gsum pa'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo gnyis bkug nas sbyar ba spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag ste/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes pas spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog /dpral bar mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon/ rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin/ ltag par snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin/ rna ltag g.yon du don yod grub pa ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing mdzes pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba bzlog nas rtse sprad de snying ga dang ltag pa dang dpral bar reg cing*/ oṃ ṭuṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gnas gsum du rdo rje'i mdud pa bcing*/ phyag rgya de nyid dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas rna ltag gnyis su dar dpyangs bcing*/

sor mo'i rtse sprad la mthil lan gsum du brdab cing*/ oṃ badzra tuṣya hoḥ zhes pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga mnyes par bya/ tshom bu rnams skad cig gis rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor shar khyams na rang gi bla ma bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ gong gi/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swa hā/ sngags dang phyag rgyas mchod yon dang*/ oṃ pra wa ra satka rā pra tītstsha swā hā/ zhabs bsil phul la/ lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas dri byug pa'i tshul bya zhing*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā sa dri chab/ mthe bong dang mdzub mo sbyar te/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā sa me tog /sor mo gzhan bskum la gung mo bsgreng ste/ oṃ iṃ swā hā sa spos/ khu tshur bcangs la mthe bong bsgreng ste/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā sa mar me/ lag pa gnyis dbus kyi sor mo bsgreng*/ oṃ i swā hā sa lha bshos/ lag pa gnyis brkyang nas se gol gtog cing*/ oṃ guṃ swā hā sa gtor ma dbul/ de nas padma'i gar sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag ste/ oṃ na maste hūm̐/ na ma mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki nī pū dzo pasthā nā ya ātma nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ oṃ ā tsārya pū dzo pasthā nā ya ātmā nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ oṃ sa ka la sa twa pa ri tra ṇā ya ātmā nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥ zhes pas lan gsum gyis phyag byas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// thams cad theg pa gsum la yang*// sbyor ba gsang ba mkha' 'gro dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo dpal lha mo// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi'o// bdag la dgongs shig thams cad kyi// rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen mchog /snang ba mtha' yas don yod sogs// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po yis// byang chub tu ni nges byas te// tshul khrims rnam gsum bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni bsdu ba dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims te// so sor bdag nyid brtan por gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi mchog

/sdom pa sangs rgyas sbyor skyes pa// dang po mchog tu gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni// so sor de bzhin nyid du gzung*// rdo rje chen po'i rigs mchog la// slob dpon nyid du gzung bar bgyi// dam tshig nyid du dag pa yi// rin chen 'byung ba'i rigs mchog la// nyin re dus drug byas nas su// sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin par bya// byang chub chen po 'byung ba yi// padma chen po'i rigs dag la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// sdom pa thams cad dang ldan pa// ji ltar nus pas mchod pa'i las// las kyi rig mchog chen po la// de bzhin nyid du so sor gzung*// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// mchog tu bskyed par byas nas su// sems can thams cad don byed phyir// sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum gyis sdom pa gzung zhing*/ tshogs rten rnams mi dmigs par gyur/ gnyis pa la/ dang po'i sbyor ba dang*/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog dang*/ las rgyal mchog gsum las/ dang po ni/ ting 'dzin phyag rgya dang ldan pas/ rang gi snying gar kṣuṃ dmar po 'od zer lnga 'phro ba/ de las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis rang gi lus dang 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad bsregs nas chos thams cad rang bzhin med par gyur/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud dho3haṃ/ chos kyi sku de las longs skur bzhengs pa'i phyir/ stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa bzhis brag cha'i rnam pa lta bur// dzdzaḥdzdzaḥdzdzaḥ rdo rje sems dpa'i dngos grub bzhugs pa'i bdag po khyod// ha ha ha ha/ hūm̐ yig mgon po dam tshig bdag po bdag phyag 'tshal// ba ba ba ba/ rdo rje sgrog gi gsang ba las byung sku 'dzin pa// a a a a/

a ho mgu ba'i rdo rje a li gcig tu thim par gyur// zhes glus bskul bas zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ dzñā na a haṃ zhes nga rgyal gzung*/ de'i steng du a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ'i yi ge las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ oṃ badzra shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bya'o/ /rdo rje las 'od zer de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang ldan pa byung ste des 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems can gyi don byas slar de nyid la zhugs pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ oṃ wartā mā no a haṃ hoḥ nga rgyal gzung*/ zla ba rdo rje sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid rnal 'byor nam mkha' sku mdog sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po sgeg pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog cing spyan gsum gsum pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga bcings pa la nor bu dang zla tshes dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spras shing thod pa lnga rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rtse phran dang sangs rgyas lngas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang sbrul la sogs pa'i rgyan/ na bza' dmar po dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rgyab tu cung zad bsnyil ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis shes rab kyi nu ma dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis padma'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis seng ge'i steng sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ de'i phang du yum ye shes dbang phyug ma dkar mo shin tu mdzes pa kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/

bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag gis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing ma mchu tshems kyis 'debs pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis sku bcings shing rdo rje padmar thim pa/ lha mo'i rgyan thams cad dang mdzes pa'i gos can bsgoms te de'i nga rgyal 'dzin pa'i phyir/ oṃ udbha ba a haṃ a ā ā aṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ de ltar phyag rgya chen po gsal bar bsam nas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddhoḥ&haṃ/ rdo rje lan gsum gsor la/ oṃ dzña na kā ya a haṃ/ de nas gnas brgyad du go cha/ spyi bor kṣuṃ/ mig gnyis la hūm̐/ rna ba gnyis dang sna la yuṃ/ lce la suṃ/ mgrin par saṃmarayu/ dpung pa gnyis la haṃmarayu/ snying gar yaṃmarayu/ lte bar kṣaṃmarayu/ dgod/ oṃ badzra kā ya hoḥ.oṃ badzra wāka ྄āḥ.oṃ badzra tsitta hūm̐/ gnas gsum byin brlabs byas nas lag pa gnyis kyi mthe'u chung mnan la phan tshun lcags sgrog ltar sbrel tegung mo gnyis rtse sprad/ lhag ma bzhi brkyang ba rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya snying ga dang mdzod spu spyi mgrin du bzhag nas/ oṃ sa ma yā haṃ/ hūm̐ hūm̐ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a dhi tiṣṭha swa māṃ/ zhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas sngar bzhin/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes/ gnas lngar rigs lngas dbang bskur ba byas/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā badzra/ zhes pas lag pa g.yas pas rdo rje/ oṃ hoḥswā hā/ zhes nga rgyal dang bcas pas dril bu dkrol/ 'phrog byed cod pan nor bu'i 'od kyis zhabs gnyis brgyan// yid 'ong lha mo thugs kar dam por btsir ba'i sku// zhabs gnyis bskyod pas gsang ba phye zhing padmar sbyor// rdo rje sems mdzes dbang phyug dam pa'i go 'phang mchog / ces brjod nas phyag rgya sogs sngar bzhin gyis/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ pra wa rā satka ra pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ dri chab/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ me tog

/oṃ iṃ swā hā/ bdug spos/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ snang gsal/ oṃ i swā hā/ zhal zas rnams kyi mchod pas mchod do// gnyis pa la rten gzhal yas khang dang*/ brten pa lha bskyed pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ de'i steng du kṣuṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du suṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du kṣuṃ las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang bcas pa'i dbus su hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ las rin po che sna bdun gyi ri rab/ de'i steng du oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par bsams nas sa'i gnas lngar brdabs pas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dang drwa ba dang bcas pa'i gur/ de'i nang du oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ gnas lngar lag pa brdabs pas/ dur khrod kyis bskor ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal yas khang gru bzh-i sgo bzhir twa ra ṇa bzhi seng ge rma bya ngang pa chu srin rnams kyis brgyan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ snam bu kha khyer drwa ba drwa phyed ba ku lā dang mda' yab grwa dang mtshams zla ba rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbus su rta babs med pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi nang re'u mig dgu pa/ de'i phyi rol na rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dang*/ phyir rim pa lngas bskor ba'i zlum po/ dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor seng ge'i gdan pad nyi'i steng gdugs dkar po dang ldan pa/ re'u mig gi shar du glang po/ byang du rma bya/ nub tu khyung*/ lhor kiṅka ra/ dbang ldan du seng ge /mer rdo rje'i phag mchu// bden bral du ma he/ rlung du spyang ki /sgo bzhir ro/ gzhan lha gnas thams cad du pad zla/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag nyid hūm̐ yig tu gyur nas dbus kyi seng ge'i gdan la gnas pa de yongs su gyur pa'i rdo rje hūm̐ gis yig mtshan pa/ oṃ warta mā no a haṃ hoḥrdo rje sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/

rnal 'byor nam mkha' sku mdog sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po sgeg pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog cing spyan gsum gsum pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga bcings pa la nor bu dang zla tshes dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spras shing thod pa lnga rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rtse phran dang sangs rgyas lngas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang sbrul la sogs pa'i rgyan/ na bza' dmar po dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rgyab tu cung zad bsnyil ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis shes rab kyi nu ma dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis padma'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis seng ge'i steng sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ de'i phang du yum ye shes dbang phyug ma dkar mo shin tu mdzes pa kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag gis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing ma mchu tshems kyis 'debs pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis sku bcings shing rdo rje padmar thim pa/ lha mo'i rgyan thams cad dang mdzes pa'i gos can

gyi bar/ de nas rang gi snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la dbus su bcom ldan 'das gdan bzhi yab yum/ shar du glang po che'i rgyal po la rol pas gnas pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du rma bya la skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'i drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma ser mo sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ nub tu bya khyung la tsog pur gnas pa'i ro langs mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ lhor kiṅka ra'i gdan la pus mo'i skyil krung gis gnas pa'i gtum mo'i mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo dbu skra bkram pa grol zhing spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ lha mo bzhi ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ glang po che'i pags pas smad/ mi'i zhing gis stod g.yogs pa/ dbang ldan du seng ge la rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i seng ge ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas kha ṭwāṃ ga 'phyar ba/ mer rdo rje phag mchu la zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i stag mo g.yas dkar g.yon nag pa/ g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ srin por ma he la skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i ce spyang ma g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas dgra st+wa 'phyar ba/ rlung du ce spyang la tsog pu'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i 'ug pa ma g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon thams cad thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ shar gyi sgo ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang gi sgo ma mar me ma ser mo spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ nub kyi sgo ma 'jib byed ma dmar mo snyims pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lho'i sgo ma skam bu 'dzi nag mo thugs kar gtun shing 'dzin ma/ phyi'i zlum po'i shar du pukka sī dang*/ khro gnyer ma dang*/ gtum mo rnams dkar mo phyag na bdud rtsi'i snod/ byang du drag mo dang*/ khrag 'thung ma dang*/ sha za ma rnams ser mo phyag na sha lngas gang ba'i padma'i snod/ nub tu khro mo dang*/ 'bar ma dang*/

'jigs byed ma rnams dmar mo phyag na gtor snod/ lhod thod 'phreng ma dang*/ rdo rje ma dang*/ bum pa ma rnams nag mo phyag na dam tshig gi zas dang btung ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ grwa bzhi'i dbang ldan du sgeg mo snyems pa'i phyag rgya can dang dri chab ma dri'i snod ser mo/ mer pi waṃ ma pi wang sgreng ba dang me tog ma me tog 'thor ba dkar mo/ bden bral du glu ma kha'i thad kar mdzub mo g.yo ba dang bdug spos ma spos phor nag mo/ rlung du gar ma gar gyi tshul du steng du thal mo sbyar ba dang mar me ma mar me sgreng ba dmar mo/ lha mo de dag thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba/ thod pa lngas brgyan pa'o// de'i phyi'i snam bu'i shar la keng rus 'jigs byed dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga'i srin po dang*/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ dril bu'i rna ba can rnams dkar po/ byang du gtum pa'i dbang phyug dang*/ 'dun pa'i lha dang*/ tsha ba'i dbang phyug dang*/ sgra 'jigs byed rnams ser po/ nub tu 'dod pa'i drag po dang*/ ṣa ṇa ḍi la'i dbang phyug dang*/ ḍā ma rus 'dul byed dang*/ rnga sgras 'jigs byed rnams dmar po/ lhor tam bu ra'i dbang phyug dang*/ sthā ḍa ṇa dang*/ mche ba gtsigs pa dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa rnams nag po chung ma dang bcas pa/ shar gyi sgo ba khyab 'jug nag po/ byang gi sgo ba tshangs pa dmar po/ nub kyi sgo ba lha chen dkar po/ lho'i sgo ba brgya byin ser po/ grwa'i dbang ldan du dbang po ser po/ mer nor lha ku be ra ser skya/ srin por 'byung po'i bdag po gshin rje nag po/ rlung du chu lha wa ru ṇa dkar po rnams chung ma gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa/ de thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang rtse gsum/ g.yon yum la 'khyud pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa nag po'i thor cog can thod 'phreng gis brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa stag gi sham thabs can/ rdzogs pa chen pos skad cig gis

bskyed par bya'o// de nas hūm̐ zhes pas zla nyi dbugs las rnal 'byor nam mkha' yab yum phyung bas dpag tu med par gyur te sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus gcig tu gyur pa dbus su bdag nyid la thim/ oṃ udbha ba a haṃ a ā ā aṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ nga rgyal gzung*/ suṃ zhes pas chu'i dbugs las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa mdun gyi re'u mig la 'khod/ suṃ badzra ḍā ki nī a haṃ/ zhes byin gyis brlab/ kṣuṃ me yi dbugs las drag mo phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa lho yi re'u mig la 'khod/ kṣuṃ go ra ḍā ki a haṃ/ yuṃ rlung gi dbugs las ro langs ma phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa nub kyi re'u mig la 'khod/ yuṃ bai tā lī a haṃ/ hūm̐ sa yi dbugs las gdol pa mo phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa byang gi re'u mig la 'khod/ hūm̐ tsaṇḍā lī ḍā ki ni a haṃḥ saṃmarayu chu me 'dres pa'i dbugs las seng ge ma phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa byang shar gyi re'u mig la 'khod/ haṃmarayu sa chu 'dres pa'i dbugs las stag mo phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa shar lho'i re'u mig la 'khod/ yaṃmarayus rlung 'dres pa'i dbugs las ce spyang ma phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa lho nub kyi re'u mig la 'khod/ kṣaṃmarayu rlung me 'dres pa'i dbugs las 'ug pa ma phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa nub byang gi re'u mig la 'khod/ phuṃ chu'i rlung las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/

pheṃ me'i rlung las mar me ma/ phoṃ rlung gi rlung las 'jib byed ma/ phriṃ sa'i rlung las skam bu 'dzi rnams phyung ba dpag tu med pas sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus gcig tu gyur pa shar byang lho nub kyi sgor 'khod/ ha hoḥhri pukka sī dang*/ khro gnyer ma dang*/ gtum mo rnams zlum po'i shar du/ kṣ+riṃ ghra/ drag mo dang*/ khrag 'thung ma dang*/ sha za ma rnams byang*/ ku ru ku ru/ khro mo dang*/ 'bar ma dang*/ 'jigs byed ma rnams nub/ oṃ brta li brta li/ thod 'phreng ma dang*/ rdo rje ma dang*/ bum pa rnams lho/ hūm̐ su pri ya gandhe hūm̐/ sgeg mo dang dri chab ma dbang ldan/ hūm̐ hoḥsriṃ/ pi waṃ ma dang me tog ma mer/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ glu ma dang bdug spos ma srin por/ su nṛ ti hūm̐ kṣuṃ/ gar ma dang mar me ma rlung*/ oṃ kuṃ a swā hā/ keng rus 'jigs byed/ oṃ khuṃ ā swā hā/ kha ṭwāṃ srin po/ oṃ guṃ i swā hā/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug oṃ ghu ī swā hā/ dril rna rnams lha snam gyi shar la/ oṃ tsuṃ u swā hā/ gtum mo'i dbang phyug /oṃ tshuṃ u swā hā/ 'dun pa'i lha/ oṃ dzuṃ ṛ swā hā/ tsha ba'i dbang phyug /oṃ dzhuṃ ṝ swā hā/ hūm̐ sgra 'jigs byed rnams byang*/ oṃ ṭuṃ l̥ swā hā/ 'dod pa'i drag po/ oṃ ṭhuṃ l̥̄ swā hā/ ṣa ṇa ḍi ka'i dbang phyug /oṃ ḍuṃ e swā hā/ ḍā ma ru'i 'dul byed/ oṃ ḍhuṃ e swā hā/ rnga sgra 'jigs byed rnams nub/ oṃ tuṃ oṃ swā hā/ taṃ bu ra'i dbang phyug /oṃ thuṃ au swā hā/ sthā ra ṇa/ oṃ duṃ aṃ swā hā/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ oṃ dhuṃ aḥswā hā/ gzhu 'dzin rnams lhor/ kheṃ/ khyab 'jug shar sgor/ oṃ oṃ/ tshangs pa byang sgor/ hūm̐/ lha chen nub sgor/ mu mu/ brgya byin lho sgor/ mu mu hūm̐/ dbang po byang shar/ a gra/ nor lha shar lho/ kha da ni/ 'byung po'i bdag po lho nub/ bhur bhuḥbaḥ chu lha rlung*/ sngags re re rdzogs pa'i skad cig gis don gnyis byas dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la zhugs pas de lhas yongs su gang bar blta'o//

gsum pa la/ ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs pa/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa/ mchod bstod bdud rtsi myang ba las dang po ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung dang sbrel nas mdzub mo cung zad bkug ste/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo bsgreng ba'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo'i rtse sbyar te/ oṃ ā karṣa ṇi hūm̐ phaṭ/ zhes pas 'jig rten pa spyan drangs/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā sa mchod yon phul/ rdo rje khu tshur bcings te mdzub mo gnyis lcags sgrog ltar sbrel la/ oṃ saṃmarayu zhes pas lha dang lhan cig 'ongs pa'i bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha phyir bstan nas mdzub mo gnyis sbrel te/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ gyis sgo bcings/ de nas thal mo sbyar nas padma'i tshul du kha bye ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas/ oṃ tiṣṭha ā sa na hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas lha thams cad gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ rang gi snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsam ste/ phyag rgya thams cad kyi thog mar padma'i gar sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ yo ga aṃ wa ra dṛṣya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma yā hoḥ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o// de bzhin du phyag rgya de nyid dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ ha swā hā/ rnal 'byor nam mkha'i dam tshig go// thal mo gnyis padma'i tshul du kha phye ba dang*/ oṃ a swā hā/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i 'o// g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan nas lhag ma gsum brkyang ba rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ suṃ swā hā/ rdo rje ma'i 'o// g.yas pa yang de ltar byas nas snga ma dang rgyab sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ drag mo'i 'o// khu tshur rgyab sprad nas kha'i phyogs su dgrol ba dang*/

oṃ yuṃ swā hā/ ro langs ma'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba rtse sprad nas rin po che'i tshul du byas pa dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ gdol pa mo'i 'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te mdzub mo gnyis lcags sgrog tu sbrel ba dang*/ oṃ saṃmarayu swā hā/ seng ge ma'i 'o// de nyid las gung mo gnyis bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ haṃmarayu swā hā/ stag mo'i 'o// de nyid las mthe'u chung gnyis lcags sgrog tu sbrel ba dang*/ oṃ yaṃmarayu swā hā/ ce spyang ma'i 'o// rdo rje khu tshur gnyis phan tshun lan gsum brdab pa dang*/ oṃ kṣaṃmarayu swā hā/ 'ug pa ma'i 'o// lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba khar bcug nas rgod pa dang*/ oṃ phuṃ phu swā hā/ mkha' 'gro ma'i 'o// thal mo sbyar ba spyi bor bzhag pa dang*/ oṃ pheṃ phu swā hā/ 'bar byed ma'i 'o// thal mo kha phye ba'i mthe bong khar bcug pa dang*/ oṃ phroṃ phu swā hā/ 'jib byed ma'i 'o// khu tshur g.yon pa rna ba'i rtsa bar sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ phriṃ phu swā hā/ 'phrog byed ma'i 'o// lag pa g.yon pa brkyang ba'i mthe bong dang srin lag sbyar ba gyen du bstan pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i thal mo dgab pa dang*/ oṃ ha hoḥhrīḥswā hā/ lan gsum/ pukka sī la sogs pa gsum gyi'o// thal mo g.yas pa brkyang ba'i steng du g.yon pa brkyang ba kha sbub te bzhag pa dang*/ oṃ kṣiṃ ghra swā hā/ lan gsum/ drag mo la sogs pa gsum gyi'o// rdo rje thal mo kha phye ba dang*/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ lan gsum/ khro mo la sogs pa gsum gyi 'o// thal mo gnyis rgyab sbyar nas sor mo rnams kyi rtse mo phan tshun gnyis bsnol ba kha sprad pa dang*/ oṃ brta li brta li swā hā/ lan gsum/ thod 'phreng ma la sogs pa gsum gyi'o/ /lag pa gnyis rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas sta zur gnyis su bzhag pa dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ sgeg mo'i 'o//

lag pa g.yon pa brkyang ba'i mthe bong dang srin lag sbyar ba steng du bstan pa'i mkhrig ma nas g.yas pas bzung ba dang*/ oṃ su pri ya gandhe hūm̐ swā hā/ dri chab ma'i 'o// pi wang bsgreng ba'i tshul dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ hoḥswā hā/ pi wang ma'i 'o// lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar nas me tog bsdus te gyen du gtor ba'i tshul dang*/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ me tog ma'i 'o// g.yas rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas mdzub mo bsgreng ste kha'i mdun du bskul ba dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ glu mkhan ma'i 'o// g.yas rdo rje khu tshur gyi mkhrig ma nas g.yon pas bzung ba dang*/ oṃ iṃ swā hā/ bdug spos ma'i 'o// lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang mdzub mo sbyar nas lhag ma brkyang ba dku g.yas par bzhag la/ g.yas pa de ltar byas pa spyi bor bzhag pa dang*/ oṃ su nṛ tya hūm̐ swā hā/ gar ma'i 'o// g.yas khu tshur bcings mthe bong bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ mar me ma'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las gung mo gnyis bsgreng ba rtse sprad pa ni keng rus 'jigs byed la sogs pa rnams kyi thun mong gi phyag rgya ste so so'i sngags ni/ oṃ kuṃ a swā hā/ keng rus 'jigs byed dang padma 'byung ma'i 'o// oṃ khuṃ ā swā hā/ kha ṭwāṃ srin po dang sen rnon ma'i 'o// oṃ guṃ i swā hā/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang sgra zab ma'i 'o// oṃ ghuṃ ī swā hā/ dril rna ma dang nu ma can gyi'o// oṃ tsuṃ u swā hā/ gtum pa'i dbang phyug dang g.yo ba'i gdong can ma'i 'o// oṃ tshuṃ ū swā hā/ 'dun pa'i lha dang so yi dral ma'i 'o// oṃ dzraṃ ṛ swā hā/ tsha ba'i dbang phyug dang bla mthon ma'i 'o// oṃ dzhuṃ ṝ swā hā/ sgra 'jigs byed dang sgra byed dga' ma'i 'o// oṃ ṭuṃ l̥ swā hā/ 'dod pa'i drag po dang thor cog can ma'i 'o// oṃ ṭhuṃ l̥̄ swā hā/ ṣa ṇa ḍi la'i dbang phyug dang dor thabs la dga' ma'i 'o// oṃ ḍuṃ e swā hā/

cang te'u phyi bzhag dang ḍi ḍi rnga dga' ma'i 'o// oṃ ḍhuṃ ai swā hā/ rnga chen 'jigs byed dang dha kas rol ma'i 'o// oṃ tuṃ o swā hā/ pi wang dbang phyug dang byin phra ma'i 'o// oṃ thuṃ au swā hā/ nga ro chen po dang rnam par g.yo ma'i 'o// oṃ duṃ aṃ swā hā/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang 'od rnon ma'i 'o// oṃ dhuṃ aḥswā hā/ gzhu 'dzin pa dang dal bus smra ma'i 'o// khu tshur g.yas pa gyen du 'phang ste dgrol ba dang*/ oṃ khe pā swā hā/ khyab 'jug gi 'o// khu tshur gnyis kyis se gol gtog pa dang*/ oṃ oṃ swā hā/ tshangs pa'i 'o// lag pa g.yas pa ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgya gyen du bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ drag po'i 'o// khu tshur g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng ba'i rtse mor g.yas pa'i thal mo dgab pa dang*/ oṃ mu mu swā hā/ brgya byin gyi'o// khu tshur g.yas pa'i gung mdzub gnyis gshibs te brkyang ba dpral bar bzhag pa dang*/ oṃ mu mu hūm̐ swā hā/ dbang po'i 'o// rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba rtse sprad nas rin po che'i tshul du byas pa dang*/

oṃ da na a ge hūm̐ swā hā/ ku bai ra'i 'o// khu tshur g.yas pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ kha da ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'byung po'i bdag po'i 'o// de nyid las gung mo yang gshibs te bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ bhur bhuḥbaḥswā hā/ wa ru ṇa'i 'o// dam rgya ste de dag bstan pas/ rang gi gzugs rnams la ye shes sems dpa' gzhug par bya'o// lha rnams kyi ljags kyi padma'i 'dab ma la rdo rje/ de'i dbus su rang rang gi sngags kyi 'phreng ba rab tu 'bar ba bsam zhing sngags brjod pa chos rgya/ gong bzhin du sngags dang phyag rgyas phyag mtshan med par 'ching zhing*/ lha rnams kyi thugs kar a las rdo rje rgya gram/ de las spro bsdu'i sbyor ba mdzad pa las rgya/ phyag mtshan dang ldan par 'ching ste rna bar mda' 'gengs pa'i tshul dang*/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ 'khyud cing nu ma 'dzin pa'i tshul dang*/ oṃ su pri ya te me hūm̐/ lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas mthe bong dang mdzub mo sbyar te lhag ma bsgreng ba rdo rje'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ de nyid g.yon pa la sbyar ba dril bu'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ aṃ swā hā/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan phyag rgyas gdab bo// lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba gsang gnas su bzhag nas mthe'u chung gnyis bskyed pa a li'i phyag rgya dang*/ oṃ a swā hā/ yum gyi rgyas gdab bo// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa 'khor rnams kyi sngags dang phyag rgya ni dam rgya dang 'dra ba las khyad par sgo ma bzhi'i rgyas gdab gyi rjes su lag pa g.yas pa'i mthe bong gis mthe'u chung mnan nas lhag ma gsum bsgreng ba dang*/ oṃ tikṣ+ṇa hāṃ swā hā/ rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi g.yas kyi mtshon cha'i sngags dang phyag rgya'o// de nyid g.yon pa la sbyar ba dang*/ oṃ ghurṇi taṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ g.yon pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya ste de dag ni phyag rgya chen po'o/ /thams cad cod pan la rnal 'byor nam mkha' bzhugs nas dbang bskur bar mdzad pa

bsam par bya'o// gsum pa ni/ de nas/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ pra wa ra satka rā pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ iṃ swā hā/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ oṃ i swā hā/ mchod yon sogs te gtor ma ma gtogs pas mchod/ de nas mchod pa nyi shu pa ni/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis dku gnyis su bzhag la hūm̐ zhes pa'i glu len zhing lte ba dang*/ snying ga dang spyi bor padma'i gar bsgyur nas slar phab la sgeg pa'i tshul bya ba phyag rgya nyi shu thams cad 'gre bas/ gdan bzhi'i cho ga gzhan las 'byung ba ltar te/pi wang tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang*// gling bu'i tshul gyis 'bud pa dang*// sil khrol tshul gyis dkrol ba dang*// dung gi tshul gyis 'bud pa dang*// gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag brkyang*// rlung g.yab tshul gyis g.yob pa dang*// rgyal mtshan tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang*// bla bre tshul gyis bre ba dang*// ba dan tshul gyis phyar ba dang*// gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab pa dang*// pheg rdob tshul gyis brdeb pa dang*// rnga yi tshul gyis brdung ba dang*// bzhad pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum pa dang*// khro ba'i tshul gyis khro ba dang*// sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang*// 'gying ba'i tshul gyis 'gying ba dang*// mda' 'dren tshul dang 'khyud pa dang*// rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal ba'i// tshul gyis 'dud par bya ba ste// phyag rgya'i mchod pa nyi shu nyid// ces brjod/ de bzhin du re re bzhin glu len bzhin gnas gsum du gar bsgyur nas slar snying ga'i thad kar la pi waṃ gi tshul dang*/ gling bu'i tshul dang*/ dung gi tshul dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul dang*/ sbrang g.yab gyi tshul dang*/ rgyal mtshan gyi tshul dang*/ bla re'i tshul dang*/ 'phan gyi tshul dang*/ gdugs kyi tshul dang*/ rdza rnga brdung ba'i tshul dang*/ rnga pa ṭa ha brdung ba'i tshul dang*/ gar byed pa'i tshul dang*/ rgod pa'i tshul dang*/

'gying ba'i tshul dang*/ khro ba'i tshul dang*/ mda' 'phang ba'i tshul dang*/ rdo rje gsor ba'i tshul dang*/ nu ma 'tshir ba'i tshul dang*/ thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul rnams kyis mchod par bya'o/ /mdzes pa'i rdo rje gsor byas nas// thams cad mya ngan 'das par dgrol// chos kyi rnam par dag byed pa// rdo rje snying po 'dzin par bya// zhes pas lha sum cu'i bdag nyid can gyi rdo rje thabs kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pas lag pa g.yas pas bzung*/ hūm̐ zhes lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi dril bu shes rab kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pas g.yon pas bzung*/ khu tshur rgyab sprad mthe'u chung sbrel nas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ni ta pra ra ni te/ sarba buddha pra tsa li te pradzña pā ra mi tā nā da swa bha be nan/ sarba bud dha hri da ya a wa to ṣi ṇi hāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swā hā/ zhes brjod/ rdo rje gsor la dril bu dkrol zhing*/ dpal ldan skal bzang kun nas kun tu bzang po chen po dang*// mnyam med ye shes kyi gnas de bzhin gshegs pa mgon po'i mgon po'o// phyag mtshan drug gis brgyan pa'i dri med sems can dag /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'ang khyod kyi zhabs kyi padmar 'dud// dpal ldan sku gsung thugs las grol ba'i zhal gsum pa// 'gying bag khro ba rgod pa de bzhin spyan yang gsum// klu dbang nor bu'i 'od mdog shin tu mdzes pa'i sku// phyag mtshan drug gis mtshan pa'i phyag mchog phyag drug pa// kha ṭwāṃ lhung bzed ral gri dgra st+wa rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// ha ha la sogs gad sgrog dmyal ba'i lang ling gcod byed pa// thar par phyin pa'i srid pa'i rang bzhin skye ba mchog /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan sangs rgyas spyi gzugs mdzes pa sku mdog dkar ba'i sku// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod 'dzin cing*// mgon med sems can kun don dkon mchog gsum 'dzin skyabs mdzad pa// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs la bdag phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan rin chen spyi gzugs shin tu gser mdog sku// kha ṭwāṃ bdud rtsi dam pas gang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin// sdug bsngal sems can mang po tshim par byed pa'i sku// drag mo mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan chos kyi spyi gzugs padma rā ga'i mdog

/kha ṭwāṃ yar bsgreng drag po'i ro chen po 'dzin pa// 'gro kun la sogs srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod byed pa// ro langs mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan las kyi spyi gzugs mdog ljang don yod gzugs// kha ṭwāṃ drag po mi yi thod pa gsar pa 'dzin// 'dod pa'i nyon mongs srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod byed ma// gdol pa'i mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan seng ge ma dang stag mo ce spyang 'ug mgo ma// sdigs mdzub zhags pa dge ba'i lcags kyu dgra st+wa can// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal mang po thams cad gcod byed ma// sprul pa'i sku rnams khyod kyi zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal// mkha' 'gro me mar 'jib byed 'phrog byed khyed rnams ni// mchog tu sa rnams srung bar byed pa drag mo rnams// sdang ba gdul dka' gzhan gyi rig pa gcod byed pa// lha yi mkha' 'gro ma kun zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal// sgeg mo yid dga' yid 'ong 'phreng ba glu len ma// shin tu gar sogs dbyangs sgra gar gyi yan lag dgu// sna tshogs rnam bkod me tog mchog gi spos snod dang*// ye shes snang ba'i mar me dge ba'i rang bzhin dri zhim zhing*// dpa' bo dbang mchog gsal bar rnal 'byor ma yi 'khor lo ni// sbyor ba shin tu sbyor ba sbyor ba chen po la// lus ngag yid kyi chags pas nan tan drag tu ni// dpal ldan gsang ba'i gdan mchog mchod gnas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan de nyid rgyal po dam pa dbang phyug spyi gzugs kyi// dpal ldan gsang ba'i gdan mchog 'od zer rab 'bar ba// dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu dkrol sbyor de bzhin nyid// dpal ldan ye shes brtan pa'i dbang phyug longs spyod 'dud// ces bstod/ oṃ shuddhaḥdharma hūm̐/ a ā a/ oṃ swā hā/ bzhi pa ni/ bza' ba dang lcags kyu lnga tshogs pa'i gtor ma khu tshur gnyis bcings mthe bong sbrel nas/

oṃ a hūm̐ hūm̐ ghūṃ phruṃ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab/ oṃ hūm̐ haḥswā hā/ ces rtsa sngags la sngar gyi sngags btags pa dang phyag rgyas phul/ de nas/ lag pa g.yas pa padmar bsam pa'i steng du ā lis gang ba'i padma'i snod bzhag /g.yon rtse gsum gyi phyag rgya rdo rje 'phyar bar bsam/ oṃ ā hoḥhriḥgṛṃ hūm̐ a swā hā/ sbyangs/ g.yon pa'i mthil du sa dbyangs dang gsal byed kyi yi ges bskor ba las bdud rtsi 'dzags pas ā li bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsam/ g.yon pa'i mthe bong sa las gser gyi sa gzhi/ srin lag hūm̐ las ri rab/ des rgya mtsho bsrubs pas bdud rtsi thon pa mgrin par mchod rten dkar po bsgoms la/ 'thor 'thung gsum phul/ gzigs shig mdzes ldan dam pa'i chos// 'di la the tshom byar mi rung*// bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams// rang bzhin gcig par dgongs te gsol// oṃ ha hoḥhrīḥ zhes pas lha thams cad la lan gsum gsum phul bas mnyes par bsam mo// de nas thod pa mdun du gzhag ste rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas rgyab sprad de srin lag gnyis dang mdzub mo gnyis lcags sgrog ltar sbrel/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa sarb+ba yo gī shā ri hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzuṃ swā hā/ oṃ swa bhā shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ badzra shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shuddhāḥsarba dhārmā yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ de nas/ gtso bo'i thugs kar rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ de'i snying gar ye shes kyi sems dpa' hūm̐/ de'i mthar sngags bkod nas 'khor rnams kyis zlos grogs byed par bsams la/ oṃ hūm̐ haḥswā hā/ yum 'khor rnams la de nyid dang gtso bo gnyis ka'i thugs kar sngags bkod gtso bos zlos des zlos grogs byed par bsam/ de nas zab pa'i snye ma bzhin du rdzogs rim bsgom/ gsum pa ni/

dub na sngar bzhin/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ sogs nas/ oṃ i swā hā/ bar gyis mchod nas/ dur khrod kyi zhing skyong nag po drag po la sogs pa bzhi bcu 'khor bcas phyogs mtshams nas/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ bha ta li ma hā bha ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ mchod chab zhabs bkru dri me tog spos mar me sngar bzhin mchod/ rgyas par mchod pa nyi shu yang bya/ ji tsam rnyed par bza' btung gi gtor ma g.yon du bzhag pa g.yas pas sdigs mdzub bsgreng*/ g.yon pa ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gtor ma la reg ste/ oṃ dur khrod dang ni shing gcig dang*// ri bo dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang gzhi mdo zhing dang ni// khyad par du ni khyim stong dang*// sems can gnas dang thang dang ni// khyad par du ni chu la gnas// nag po drag po chen po drag chen po// lha sbyin mnyam du brten pa dang*// nag po rtsigs dang mi sdug dang*// rga las 'das dang log 'dren dang*// rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang*// 'jigs byed ma dang u ma dang*// rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang*// mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma// nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo// nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma// dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo// drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo// 'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma// 'jigs byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma// drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo// mche ba gtsigs dang thod chen mo// thod phreng 'phreng dang kha ṭwāṃ ga /sbrul chen ral gri dgra st+wa can// rdo rje'i de ni gzhu can ma// de nyid chen mo mkha' 'gro lnga// las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa// sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo// de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo// rdul med rnal 'byor sbyin pa mo// rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis// thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig

/ lan gsum brjod pas dgug /oṃ ka ka kā dha na/ ba ba bandha na/ kha kha khā dha na/ sarba duṣṭan/ ha na ha na/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a mu ka sya i daṃ ka ra ye/ sa da ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ dza swā hā/ las so so'i sham bu kha bsgyur bas bskul/ bdud rtsis kha yongs su bkang*/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya spyi bor bcings nas mngon par 'dod pa'i dngos po yid la byas nas/ khyed kyi nges pa'i don du dgos pa gyis shig ces sbyar te gtor ma la kha phru btab/ oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharm+mā ṇāṃ ā dya nutpanna twātta oṃ bhruṃ zhes pas bsngos/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog / ces pa'i 'dod pa gsol/ oṃ bhyo brta li ma hā brta li tshe/ zhes pas dud pa'i sol ba ma 'khor bcas spyan drangs la/ oṃ ku ru ku ru bha ta li bha ta li ma hā bha ta li/ dur khrod bdag mo dngos grub zhal// gtum mo gtsigs byed yi dwags kha// dam tshig srung ma khrag dga' mo// kī li'i sgra sgrog sbyor zin ma// dur khrod ro yi tshal dbus nas// tshogs dang pho nyar bcas pa ru// gtsigs byed gtum mo dud sol ma// gsol zhig bzhes shig dam tshig lha// gnas nas gnas par mdzad du gsol// bdag gi sems la ci 'dod pa// de bzhin khyod kyis sgrub par gyis/ ku ru hūm̐/ gṛhṇa gṛhṇa sarba duṣṭān bhakṣa bhakṣa phraṃ phriṃ phreṃ phraṃ swā hā/ 'khor dang bcas pas hab dir gyis gsol bar bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur mdzub mo gnyis mche ba'i tshul gyis kha'i grwar bzhag /gshegs su gsol/ de nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ pra wa ra satka rā pra tītstsha swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ iṃ swā hā/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ oṃ i swā hā/ bar gyis mchod nas/ sems dpa' chen po dang po mchog

/dga' ba chen po dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snying po gtso bo'i gtso// thugs kyi sems dpa' ting 'dzin mchog /rdo rje rdo rje chen po'i stobs// kun tu bzang po spyod pa'i stobs// bdud dang bdud ni rab 'joms pa// kun gyi khro bo khro chen po// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas chos skyes mchog /rdo rje hūm̐ byed hūm̐ byed pa// 'jig rten dbang phyug nor bu sbyin// chags pa chen po bde ba che// 'dod pa thar pa don chen po// srid gsum 'jig rten nor gyi mchog /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum la// mi g.yo rab mchog mi gsal ba// shin tu phra dang rags 'dus pa// g.yo dang rab mchog thob pa yi// srid dang 'khor ba dag byed pa// thog ma med pa mtha' med pa// thog ma mtha' dang sngon phyi dang*// thams cad du ni yang dag gnas// snying po phyag rgya dam tshig sbyor// de bzhin nyid sems mchod pa che// rdo rje khro bo khro chen po// 'jigs pa'i 'bar ba 'dul byed pa// sdang ba chen po mchog tu 'dul// mi bzad drag po'i 'jigs byed pa// de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa che// chos dang las dang che ba'i mchog /dam pa'i chos dang las gyi lam// byang chub sems ni rgyas par byed// kun gyi dag pa padma che// thabs dang shes rab nor che ba// 'dod chags dag pa ting 'dzin mchog /sna tshogs 'dod chags dbang phyug che// nam mkha' mtha' yas rtag pa'i don// 'byung ba chen po kun gyi gzhi// longs spyod dpal gyi rgyal po gtso// 'dod pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa// phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal bstod// gus pas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje sems dpa' de dag 'grub// oṃ bdag gi cho ga ma tshang rnams// bcom ldan 'das la bzod par gsol//

zhes brjod nas/ rdo rje thal mo snying gar bzhag ste/ sems can thams cad nad med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur te// gang gi lam gnas 'gro ba yis// sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// da ltar rjes su brtse ba'i phyir// rnal 'byor gtsug lag bdag bgyis so// oṃ zhes brjod la/ oṃ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// sems can phan par mdzad pa dang*// sangs rgyas yul du byon nas kyang*// slar yang 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes brjod cing g.yon pa rdo rje khu tshur bcings te snying gar bzhag la/ g.yas pa'i lag pa brkyang la sa la bzhag ste/ oṃ da ma tista hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba duṣṭa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gatstsha gatstsha hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces se gol gyis phyi'i lha gshegs su gsol lo/ /rang gi dbugs kyis bsdus te ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha mo ni spyi bo mig rna ba sna lcer/ seng ge ma sogs mgrin dpung snying lte ba/ sgo bsrung bzhi ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi brla dang rje ngar gnyis su/ pukka sī sogs lce/ drag mo sogs brang*/ gtum mo sogs kha/ thod 'phreng ma sogs lcer/ sgeg sogs brgyad snying nu bar mgrin pa/ mgo bo so gsang ba/ dpung pa/ mig la yi ge'i rnam par/ keng rus 'jigs byed sogs sems dpa' bcu drug dbugs dang 'od zer/ 'jig rten pa'i lha chen brgyad ba spu'i khung dang rkang sogs la rim pa bzhin du yi ge'i gzugs su 'khod par gyur/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas 'god par bya'o// ༈ //da ni dbang bskur ba'i rim pa bshad par bya ste/ slob ma brtag pa la 'jug pa dang sngon du bsnyen pa dang lha dbab pa'i phyir/ oṃ badzra ā be sha/ 'bum phrag gsum gyis mthong bas 'bebs pa dang*/ oṃ ma ta li hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'bum phrag gsum gyis thos pas dang*/ oṃ ma ta li tsi ta tsa li te huṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/

'bum phrag gcig gis ring nas 'bebs pa dang*/ oṃ bha tā li bha ta li hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'bum phrag gsum bzlas pas ming nas brjod pa tsam gyis lha thams cad 'bebs par 'gyur ba dang*/ oṃ pa ta li pa ta li hūm̐ phaṭ/ 'bum phrag gcig tu bsnyen na chu dang gseg ma rdo shing rnams kyang 'bebs par 'gyur bar gsung*/ bsnyen nas dmigs pa gzhan ye shes 'bebs pa nas 'byung ba ltar/ slob dpon seng ge ma'i gzugs su gnas pa sngags de dag gis bsngags pa'i chu dang bcas pa'i me tog gtor/ oṃ ra ma ra ma hoḥhoḥhoḥ.a a a phaṭ/ ces brjod/ ra rog po'i yan lag lnga nywa bzhi lce dang bcas la 'byung ba lnga'i sa bon bzlas/ snying gar ye shes kyi sa bon sbyar/ gu gul chen po mar nag chen po dang sngar gyi lnga cha mnyam par bsres pa bdud rtsir chu dang gu gul dang sbyar ba la rdo rje sa bon hūm̐ bzlas la des gdab/ bdud rtsi lnga/ lcags kyu lnga/ bcu mar nag chen po dang cha mnyam chang la sbyar ba khar sbyin pas phab pas babs pa dag dam tshig can/ bzlog pa skal med/ dang po sor byang gi sdom pa gnyis la bkod pa rjes su 'dzin pa'i phyir/ snying rje'i sems kyis sa'i phyogs dag par song nas gnas nye bar brgyan/ mchod gtor sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas te/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnal 'byor nam mkha'i skur gsal bar gyur par bsam la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du a dmar po las sogs nas/ 'phrog byed cod pan sogs mthar chu gnyis nyer spyod kyis mchod pa'i bar gyis dang po'i sbyor ba rdzogs par byas la/ stegs bu'i dbus su maṇḍal la dri'i thig le dang*/ tshom bu bkod pa'i mthar mchod yon dang nyer spyod gtor ma bcas bshams la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las mdun du laṃ las skyes pa'i sa yi lha mo sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ g.yas khas len pa'i phyag rgya dang*/

g.yon rin po che'i bum pa bsnams zhing dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ lte ba yan chad sa gseb nas thon te 'khod par bsam la/ dril bu bsil zhing*/ oṃ/ tshur byon tshur byon lha mo che// sa yi lha mo 'jig rten yum// rin chen kun gyis rab gang ma// mchog gi rgyan gyis rab tu brgyan// mgul do zhabs gdub sil sil can// rdo rje sems dpa' rab mchod ma// mchod yon 'di ni bzhes mdzod la// dkyil 'khor las rnams rtag tu sgrub// hrī hi hi baṃ swā hā/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ oṃ iṃ swā hā/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ oṃ i swā hā/ bcas nyer spyod lngas mchod/ oṃ guṃ swā hā/ lan gsum phyag rgya dang bcas pas gtor ma phul/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi// sa dang pha rol phyin rnams la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa shākya seṅge yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de ltar bdag gis bdud kyi sde// pham par bya phyir dkyil 'khor bri// zhes dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur dku gnyis su bzhag nas/ mdzes ma khyod la bdag gsol 'debs// bdag la bka' drin mdzad du gsol// oṃ hūm̐ dzuṃ dzuṃ dzuṃ dzuṃ swā hā/ de ltar gsol ba btab pas/ phyogs 'dir ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin nas/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa de nyid du thim par bsam la/ sa'i lha mo las sa bslang ngo*/ tshom bu dang mchod pa bsdus te rkyang nul bya/ de nas/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā badzra/ zhes pas rdo rje dang*/ oṃ hoḥswā hā/ zhes pas dril bu bzung nas mnyam par bzhag / bum pa'i nang du skad cig gis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gzugs mdzes pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa/ 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/

padma'i gdan la bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dzaḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ de bzhin shrīṃ= iṃ= kṣuṃ= i= lngas mchod/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng rtse mo bkug pa snying gar bcas te/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes dam tshig la bzhag rdo rje rtse mos bum par reg nas sngags de brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ de nas slob ma bzhi/ ma 'byor na tha na slob dpon rang nyid kyis bdud la sogs pa bskrad pa'i phyir/ sprul pa'i dkyil 'khor pa rnams dbugs kyis drangs te rang gi lus kyi gnas so sor gzhug par gyur/ rang nyid rnal 'byor nam mkhar gsal ba'i spyi bor kṣuṃ/ mig gnyis la hūm̐/ rna ba gnyis dang sna la yuṃ/ lce la suṃ/ mgrin par saṃmarayu/ dpung pa gnyis la haṃmarayu/ snying gar yaṃmarayu/ lte bar kṣaṃmarayu rnams kyis mtshan par gyur/ ces go bgo/ oṃ badzra kā ya ho/ oṃ badzra wāk āḥ oṃ badzra tsitta hūm̐/ zhes rgyas gdab/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes dbang bskur/ oṃ ṭuṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ rdo rje mdud pa bcing*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ dar dpyang bcing*/ de nas rdo rje slob dpon rdo rje dang dril bu thogs la gzhi der song ste bgegs thams cad shes par byas la 'greng nas gnas te/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /ngas ni gnas 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bri// khyed rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// zhes dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis nu steng du bcing nas/ oṃ/ gang su yang rung ba'i gnas kyi bdag por gyur pa rnams gzhan du dengs shig /sa'i phyogs 'dir sems can gyi don rtsom gyis/ klu dang gnod sbyin la sogs pa dang*/ dri za dang 'byung po dang 'byung mo dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams myur ba nyid du song zhig /oṃ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ suṃ bha ni

brjod cing bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje bskor zhing cod pan 'phangs zhing dril bu dkrol bas shar sgor song*/ gzhi bca'/ hūm̐ zhes brjod/ mnyam pa dang mi mnyam pa dang*/ gcig bskum pa dang g.yon brkyang ba'i stangs stabs bya/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje khro mo'i skur gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ hūm̐ ha na ha na mā ra ya duṣṭān ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ aḥ.aḥ hūm̐ hrīḥphaṭ/ byang sgor song ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis drag mo mkha' 'gro mar gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis rdor dril dang bcas thal mo snying gar sbyar te g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang sa ga dang zlum po'i stabs/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥphaṭ/ de nas nub sgor song ste/ rang nyid skad cig gis ro langs mkha' 'gro ma gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis rdor dril dang bcas pas lag pa rked par btsugs/ pus mo sbyar dang g.yon snyems bcas g.yon bskor seng ge'i stabs/ oṃ hūm̐ aṃ phaṭ/ de nas lho sgor song la/ rang nyid skad cig gis gtum mo mkha' 'gro ma gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis rdo rje dang dril bu dang bcas pas spyi bor thal mo sbyar/ pus mo'i rkang stabs dang*/ rus sbal stabs dang*/ bskor ba dang*/ bzlog stabs bya/ oṃ hūm̐ aḥphaṭ/ ces pas phyogs mtshams dang*/ de nas shar du logs pas slar yang 'phen pa'i stabs/ g.yas kyis rdo rje snying gar bzung*/ rang nyid skad cig gis ye shes mkha' 'gro ma gsal ba'i nga rgyal gyis hūm̐ zhes brjod cing gzhi bca'/ g.yas brkyang g.yon brkyang*/ g.yas bskum g.yon bskum/ des dbus dang 'og gi bgegs bcom/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i nga rgyal gyis sems dpa'i dkyil krung bcas lag gnyis kha sbyar ba'i sor mo rnams brkyang ba'i rtse mo sprad/ oṃ hūm̐ phu bu phaṭ/ drwa ba dang bcas pa'i rdo rje'i gur du gyur/ rdo rje thal mo bcings nas mthe bong gnyis bsgreng*/ mthe'u chung gnyis sbyar te brgyang nas phyogs brgyad du bskor/

oṃ dzambha na hūm̐ phaṭ/ rwa ba chen po mi shigs pas kun nas bskor bar gyur/ lag pa gnyis rdo rje rtse mo lnga pa sa la gnas lngar bsnun pas/ oṃ hūm̐ phuṃ phaṭ/ sa 'og phur bu dang bcas pa'i sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhir bsam pas dkyil 'khor bsrung ngo*// nub gnyis pa'i cho ga'o// (gdan bzhi'i cho ga gzhan du skabs 'dir lha sta gon mdzad pa'i lugs su snang yang 'dir dkyus su mi 'byung*/) /de nas slob dpon dpa' bo'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan te 'bol ba'i stan la 'dug nas bum pa chus bkrus shing*/ oṃ tapte tapte ma hā tapte hūm̐ swā hā/ lan gsum gyis lha'i chu bo gadgā bkug par bsam/ 'o ma dang dri zhim po sna tshogs dang me tog dang bdud rtsi lnga bsres/ shing los brgyan/ mgul dkris/ me tog gi 'phreng ba'i gzungs thag btags/ g.yon ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas de rnams la reg cing*/ oṃ hūm̐ suṃ kṣuṃ yuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ sngar bzhin bzhag go// de nas/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du a dmar po las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ mdzub mo la suṃ/ gung mo la kṣuṃ/ srin lag la yuṃ/ mthe'u chung la ham̐'u/ mthe bong la a las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ g.yon pa'i mthil du sa dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ mdzub mo la saṃmarayu/ gung mo la haṃmarayu/ srin lag la yaṃmarayu/ mthe'u chung la kṣaṃmarayu/ mthe bong la paṃ las padma 'dab ma lnga pa/ g.yon pa ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas reg cing*/ spyi bor kṣuṃ/ mig gnyis la hūm̐/ rna ba gnyis dang sna la yuṃ/ lce la suṃ/ mgrin par saṃmarayu/ dpung pa gnyis la haṃmarayu/ snying gar yaṃmarayu/ lte bar kṣaṃmarayu/ dgod/ yang lag pa gnyis kyi sor mo brkyang*/ mthe bong bsnol ba ngang pa'i gshog pa lta bu phyir bzlog ste kha nang du bstan pas/ oṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ lus thams cad la rdo rje'i go cha legs par bsam/ sogs nas/ bdag bskyed bzlas pa'i bar byas/ de nas/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/

de bzhin shrīṃ= iṃ= kṣuṃ= i= ces dri la sogs pa lngas mchod/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gnas gsum du gtug cing*/ oṃ badzra kā ya hoḥ.oṃ badzra wākkā āḥ.oṃ badzra hṛ da ya hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ badzra shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shuddhāḥsarba dhārmā yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ ces dag pa gsum brjod/ de ni bdag nyid mngon par byang chub pas rol pa'i cho ga'o// de nas bum pa lha grangs yod na so sor bskyed dgos kyang rnam bum kho na'i tshe rtsa ba'i lha bcu gsum kho na bskyed pa gong ma'i phyag bzhes yin pas de ltar na/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar seng khri pad dkar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ steng du gdugs dkar pos mdzes pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la so so'i khri dang pad zla/ phyogs bzhir pad nyi ro gdan dang bcas pa gsal ba'i gdan dbus ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor nam mkha' sku mdog sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po sgeg pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog cing spyan gsum gsum pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga bcings pa la nor bu dang zla tshes dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spras shing thod pa lnga rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rtse phran dang sangs rgyas lngas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang sbrul la sogs pa'i rgyan/ na bza' dmar po dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rgyab tu cung zad bsnyil ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis shes rab kyi nu ma dang mda'/ g.yon gnyis padma'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis seng ge'i steng sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/

de'i phang du yum ye shes dbang phyug ma dkar mo shin tu mdzes pa kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag gis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing ma mchu tshems kyis 'debs pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis sku bcings shing rdo rje padmar thim pa/ lha mo'i rgyan thams cad dang mdzes pa'i gos can/ phyogs bzhir suṃ kṣuṃ yuṃ hūm̐/ mtshams bzhir saṃmarayu haṃmarayu yaṃmarayu kṣaṃmarayu/ sgor phuṃ pheṃ phroṃ phreṃ/ rnams rim pa bzhin yongs su gyur pa las shar du glang po che'i rgyal po la rol pas gnas pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du rma bya la skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'i drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma ser mo sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ nub tu bya khyung la tsog pur gnas pa'i ro langs mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ lhor kiṅka ra'i gdan la pus mo'i skyil krung gis gnas pa'i gtum mo'i mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo dbu skra bkram pa grol zhing spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ lha mo bzhi ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ glang po che'i pags pas smad/ mi'i zhing gis stod g.yogs pa/ dbang ldan du seng ge la rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i seng ge ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/ g.yas kha ṭwāṃ ga 'phyar ba/ mer rdo rje phag mchu la zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i stag mo g.yas dkar g.yon nag pa/ g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ srin por ma he la skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i ce spyang ma g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas dgra st+wa 'phyar ba/ rlung du ce spyang la tsog pu'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i 'ug pa ma g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon thams cad thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ shar du mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang du mar me ma ser mo spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ nub tu 'jib byed ma dmar mo snyims pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/
lho ru skam bu 'dzi nag mo thugs kar gtun shing 'dzin ma/ lha mo de dag thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba/ thod pa lngas brgyan pa'o/

/zhes pa'i bar gyis bskyed la sngags dang phyag rgyas spyan 'dren par bya ba ste/ nam mkha'i khams kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdul phra rab kyi gzugs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad par brtson pa rnams/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te g.yas pa'i mdzub mo g.yon pa'i the'u chung dang sbrel nas mdzub mo cung zad bkug ste/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes pas 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lha/ g.yon rdo rje khu tshur las gung mo bsgreng ba'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo'i rtse sbyar te/ oṃ a karṣa ni hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes pas 'jig rten pa spyan drangs/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ pra wa rā satka ra pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ dri chab/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ me tog /oṃ iṃ swā hā/ bdug spos/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ snang gsal/ oṃ i swā hā/ zhal zas rnams kyi mchod pas mchod do/ /oṃ saṃmarayu zhes pa'i sngags rgyas phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ gyis sgo bcings/ oṃ tiṣṭha ā sa na hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gnyis med du brtan par byas/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog /dpral bar mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon/ rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin/ ltag par snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin/ rna ltag g.yon du don yod grub pa ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing mdzes pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pas dbang bskur ba dang ldan par gyur/ gzhan lha thams cad kyi cod pan la rnal 'byor nam mkha' rigs kyi bdag por gnas pas rgyas gdab par gyur/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba bzlog nas rtse sprad de snying ga dang ltag pa dang dpral bar reg cing*/ oṃ ṭuṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/

zhes pas gnas gsum du rdo rje'i mdud pa bcing*/ phyag rgya de nyid dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas rna ltag gnyis su dar dpyangs bcing*/ sor mo'i rtse sprad la mthil lan gsum du brdab cing*/ oṃ badzra tuṣya hoḥ zhes pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga mnyes par bya/ de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ saṃ sho dha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsang gtor dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā sa byin gyis brlabs/ de nas spro na mchod pa 'bul ba'i tshigs bcad dang bcas pa'am/ bsdu na/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ mchod yon/ oṃ pra wa rā satka ra pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ dri chab/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ me tog /oṃ iṃ swā hā/ bdug spos/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ snang gsal/ oṃ i swā hā/ zhal zas rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ pi wang tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang*// gling bu'i tshul gyis 'bud pa dang*// sil khrol tshul gyis dkrol ba dang*// dung gi tshul gyis 'bud pa dang*// gar gyi tshul gyis yan lag brkyang*// rlung g.yab tshul gyis g.yob pa dang*// rgyal mtshan tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang*// bla bre tshul gyis bre ba dang*// ba dan tshul gyis phyar ba dang*// gdugs kyi tshul gyis dgab pa dang*// pheg rdob tshul gyis brdeb pa dang*// rnga yi tshul gyis brdung ba dang*// bzhad pa'i tshul gyis 'dzum pa dang*// khro ba'i tshul gyis khro ba dang*// sgeg pa'i tshul gyis sgeg pa dang*// 'gying ba'i tshul gyis 'gying ba dang*// mda' 'dren tshul dang 'khyud pa dang*// rdo rje gsor zhing phyag 'tshal ba'i// tshul gyis 'dud par bya ba ste// phyag rgya'i mchod pa nyi shu nyid// ces mchod pa nyi shu dang bcas pas mchod/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ste/ rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol nas sgeg cing rgod pas hūm̐ glur len pa dang bcas/ rin thang med pa'i bdud rtsi yis// sems can rnams ni khyod kyis bkrus// bdag ni 'khor ba las sgrol ba// khyod la gus dang bcas pas 'dud// te na hūm̐ te na te te hūm̐/

glang chen mchog gi steng bzhugs pa// sku ni dung ltar dkar bas mdzes// mtha' yas dung gis brgyan pa'i sku// shar gtso rdo rje ma la 'dud// gser gyi mchog ltar mdzes pa'i sku// shin tu drag po sbrul gyis brgyan// mdzes pa'i zas gang thod pa can// byang gi lha mo rgyal gyur cig /padma dmar ltar mdzes pa'i sku// hūm̐ gi nga ro 'jigs par mdzad// drag po dbyug pa thod pa bsnams// nub kyi lha mo gtso la 'dud// 'od zer dra ba sngon pos mdzes// seng ge 'phrog byed tshangs dbang gtso// bdud 'dul phyir ni khro gzugs 'dzin// hūm̐ mdzad lho yi lha mor 'dud// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas lnga yi mkha' 'gro ma// lnga lnga rnam par dag pa'o// rnal 'byor ma kun de nyid sprul// stong dang stong min 'khor ba'i dngos// dngos dang dngos med grol ba nyid// de 'dra'i sku ni dbus bzhugs nas// rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis bskor// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma yi sku// dkyil 'khor bye ba de yis mnyes// glu sogs chags pa'i rang bzhin nyid// bza' dang bza' min sngon nas spangs// dang po yi ni rdo rje yis// padma la ni bskyod par mdzad// bdud rtsi lnga yis bdag la bkrus// lcags kyu gsol ba'i sbyor ba bsten// bzhengs shig kha sbyar sbyor ba mdzod// dam chos snying po rgyas mdzad pa// dam chos thar pa gtso bo'i gtso// yang dag rgyal ba 'khor ba spangs// dkyil 'khor spro bas 'gro bar sgrol// bdud gsol seng ge ma yi sku// stag mos shin tu skrag par mdzad// 'ug pa'i sgra yis yid skrag cing*// phaiṃ phaiṃ sgrog pas sdang lus gzigs// dpa' bo rdo rje khyod la 'dud// 'khor ba sgrol ba khyod la 'dud// gsang bas bdud rtsi gsol la 'dud// gus dang bcas par phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa'i bar gyis bstod/ oṃ shuddhe dharme hūm̐/ a āḥ.oṃ swā hā/

ces bstod par rgyas gdab bya/ de nas me tog gi phreng ba bzung ste/ lha rnams kyi sngags brgya rtsa sogs ci rigs par bzlas pa'i mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mchod yon phul bas lha 'od du zhu bas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi chur gyur par bsam/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i dbus su pad nyi'i gdan la skad cig gis rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma gzugs mdzes pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing rdo rje dang dril bu bsnams pa 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba'i skur gsal bar gyur/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ shrīṃ= iṃ= i= guṃ= rnams kyis dri me tog bdug pa lha bshos gtor ma dang bcas mchod/ rdo rje bsdams pa las mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng rtse mo bkug pa snying gar bcas te/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes dam tshig la bzhag /rdo rje rtse mos bum par reg nas/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas/ dkyil 'khor gyi las ma grub kyi bar du bgegs thams cad bsrung bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas rdzas lnga la sogs pa sta gon du bya ba ni/ dri'i chus gru bzhi byugs pa la rdul tshon gyis pad 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su las bum dang tshon sngon po'i snod/ thig skud kha dog lnga pa shar/ rdo rje lho/ dril bu byang*/ bdud rtsi lnga'i dung chos nub/ tshon sna bzhi'i snod mtshams su bzhag /oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā sa thig tshon bsang gtor byas te/ stong pa'i ngang las thig skud lnga dang*/ tshon sna lnga lha mo lnga yi ngo bor gyur pa ni/ sngon po hūm̐ las ye shes mkha' 'gro ma sku mdog sngon mo/ dkar po suṃ las rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ ser po kṣuṃ las drag mo mkha' 'gro ma ser mo/ dmar po yuṃ las ro langs mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ ljang khu hūm̐ las gdol pa mkha' 'gro ma ljang khu/ thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis kha ṭwāṃ dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul la sogs pa'i rgyan dang*/

glang po che dang mi lpags kyi na bza' 'chang ba pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ dri chab/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ me tog /oṃ iṃ swā hā/ bdug spos/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ snang gsal/ oṃ i swā hā/ zhal zas rnams so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ dpal ldan sku gsung thugs las grol ba'i zhal gsum pa// 'gying bag khro ba rgod pa de bzhin spyan yang gsum// klu dbang nor bu'i 'od mdog shin tu mdzes pa'i sku// phyag mtshan drug gis mtshan pa'i phyag mchog phyag drug pa// kha ṭwāṃ lhung bzed ral gri dgra st+wa rdo rje dril bu 'dzin// ha ha la sogs gad sgrog dmyal ba'i lang ling gcod byed pa// thar par phyin pa'i srid pa'i rang bzhin skye ba mchog /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis phyag 'tshal bstod// dpal ldan sangs rgyas spyi gzugs mdzes pa sku mdog dkar ba'i sku// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i snod 'dzin cing*// mgon med sems can kun don dkon mchog gsum 'dzin skyabs mdzad pa// rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs la bdag phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan rin chen spyi gzugs shin tu gser mdog sku// kha ṭwāṃ bdud rtsi dam pas gang ba'i lhung bzed 'dzin// sdug bsngal sems can mang po tshim par byed pa'i sku// drag mo mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan chos kyi spyi gzugs padma rā ga'i mdog /kha ṭwāṃ yar bsgreng drag po'i ro chen po 'dzin pa// 'gro kun la sogs srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod byed pa// ro langs mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan las kyi spyi gzugs mdog ljang don yod gzugs// kha ṭwāṃ drag po mi yi thod pa gsar pa 'dzin// 'dod pa'i nyon mongs srid pa'i 'ching ba gcod byed ma// gdol pa'i mkha' 'gro ma khyod zhabs gnyis la phyag 'tshal//

zhes pas bstod/ hūm̐ sum̐ kṣum̐ yum̐ hūm̐/ gang 'grub bzlas/ rigs lnga'i lha mo zhu ba las thig tshon so so'i rnam par gyur/ nub kyi dung chos ni dam chu dang ye shes dbab pa la dgos pas de dag gi sngags tsam brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas phyogs brgyad kyi zhing skyong la gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis dur khrod kyi zhing skyong nag po drag po la sogs pa 'khor bcas phyogs mtshams nas lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ bha ta li bha ta li ma hā bha ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas bkug pa nas bzung sgrub thabs kyi gtor chog bzhin/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub mdzod// ces pas 'dod don gsol/ oṃ sarba duṣṭa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gatstsha gatstsha hūm̐ phaṭ/ ces gshegs su gsol lo// de nas rdzas thams cad bsdus te lho yi phyogs 'gol sar bzhag /sa gzhi de dris byug go// de ltar dkyil 'khor gyi shar ram byang du cho ga rdzogs par byas nas/ de nas slob ma sta gon ni/ slob ma mdun du bos/ so shing sor bcu gnyis pa 'o ma can gyi shing las byas pa rtser me tog bcings/ maṇḍal tshom bu lnga rigs lngar btags par/ oṃ a dzi ho saṃ warta ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ lan bdun bzlas pas thal mo gnyis kyi bar du bzung*/ rtsa ba so la drud de dor ba rtse mo bstan pa'i phyogs kyi dngos grub kyi pra brtag /bdud rtsi lcags kyu dri dang 'o mar bcas pa'i chu/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ āḥswā hā/ lan bdun bzlas pa dam tshig gi chu 'og nas 'byung ba'i sngags tshig gis blud pas kha bkru/ rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen mchog /snang ba mtha' yas don yod sogs// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po yis// byang chub tu ni nges byas te// tshul khrims rnam gsum bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni bsdu ba dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims te// so sor bdag nyid brtan por gzung*// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// bla med dkon mchog gsum gyi mchog

/sdom pa sangs rgyas sbyor skyes pa// dang po mchog tu gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni// so sor de bzhin nyid du gzung*// rdo rje chen po'i rigs mchog la// slob dpon nyid du gzung bar bgyi// dam tshig nyid du dag pa yi// rin chen 'byung ba'i rigs mchog la// nyin re dus drug byas nas su// sbyin pa rnam bzhi sbyin par bya// byang chub chen po 'byung ba yi// padma chen po'i rigs dag la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam chos so sor gzung bar bgyi// sdom pa thams cad dang ldan pa// ji ltar nus pas mchod pa'i las// las kyi rig mchog chen po la// de bzhin nyid du so sor gzung*// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// mchog tu bskyed par byas nas su// sems can thams cad don byed phyir// sdom pa ma lus gzung bar bgyi// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces sdom pa byin/ theg pa chen po 'bras 'byung ba// dpal ldan mchog gi lam 'di yin// gang gis khyed rnams dgrol 'gyur ba// de bzhin gshegs par 'gyur ba yin// slob ma'i gnas gsum du dri'i thig le bya zhing lhag par gnas pa 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bya/ mchod pa lnga phul/ rtsa rgyud las/ tshe rabs snga ma rtogs chub pa// rnal 'byor pa ni stong la 'ga'// zhes gsungs/ 'dir zhugs pa'i phan yon ni// de nyid las/ nyon cig rdo rje ji ltar lam// mnyam gzhag pa yi gtsug lag gi// yi ge dang ni tshig rkang tsam// gang dag nyan byed de dag ni// mtho ris longs spyod thob par 'gyur// yang na 'khor lo bskor bar ro// 'drir bcug 'dri ba klog pa dang*// sngags zlos pa dang dad pa can// lus can 'chi 'pho dus su de// gzugs med srid pa'i sems grub bo// sbyor dang bsam gtan byed pa ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub myur thob bo// zhes gsungs so//

de nas sems mgu ba'i slob ma la dkyil 'khor 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin bstan/ slob ma gyes/ bla mas rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis/ 'phrog byed cod pan zhes pa'i shlo ka gcig gis glu blang ngo*/ slob ma lhag gnas so// ༈ /de nas dkyil 'khor gyi las rim la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gnas nye bar brgyan nas kha dog lnga'i skud pa dgu yi bdag nyid can legs par bsgril ba hūm̐ zhes brjod pas bzung zhing*/ bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs su gyur par mos/ thal mo sbyar ba'i dbus su bzhag oṃ a āḥ.a a swā hā/ sna gcig slob ma la gtad de thig brgyad dbang ldan nas brtsams te zur gnyis dang shar nub lho byang de nas gru bzhir gdab bo// de nas las thig mnyam gsum phyi gshags de re cha// nang ma'i dbus dor phyi phyed du// 'khor lo lnga cha sgo de'i phyed// rta babs bzhi dang bzhi lnga phran// nang phyi yang brgyad snam tshon sa// mnyam pa nang ma yang mnyam gsum// phyi lnga nang nas lnga gcig gsum// bskor dbus re mig har mig dang*// rwa dang gdugs pad 'khor gzhan 'dra// legs par gdab/ tshon bkye/ rdul tshon ma byas na ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor bkram/ sgo y-i zur brgyad du rgyal dang bkra shis shar/ dngos grub rdzu 'phrul byang*/ rgyal ba zhi ba nub/ grub pa 'jigs pa lho/ gzhan grwar/ rnam rgyal dbus/ las thams cad pa sgo yi g.yon du'o// bum pa gnyis las med na rnam rgyal g.yon dang las thams cad pa byang shar du bzhag /dkyil 'khor gyi mthar bsrung ba'i yan lag gi ral gri/ mda' dar/ me long*/ tshon skud kyi drwa ba sogs kyang 'dzoms na bkram/ med kyang rung*/ dbu rgyan sogs dbang gi rdzas dang*/ sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas bkang ba'i thod pa brgyad/ me tog dkar po/ bdug spos/ sa lu'i zan/ zho/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsir bcas pa'i gtor ma dbang ldan nas dang*/ chang gi snod/ lha bshos/ nya/ sha sna tshogs/ sran ma/ zan/

til/ 'khur ba la sogs pa'i bza' ba bden bral/ zho dang mar/ sbrang rtsi/ mar khu/ bza' ba zhim por bcas pa me'i mtshams/ dri/ me tog /bdug pa/ mar me sogs mchod pa rgyas par bshams/ tshogs kyi yo byad dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma gtong ba'i chas/ khyad par du thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srung dud sol ma'i gtor ma gtsang zhing legs pa bcas bshams/ bsang gtor gyi dung chos/ ḍā dril nang mchod sogs dgos pa'i yo byad rnams 'du bya/ de nas sgrub cing mchod pa dngos la/

rang nyid skad cig gis rnal 'byor nam mkha'i skur gsal btab la/ lag pa g.yas pa'i mthil du sogs nas mchod pas mchod do// zhes pa'i bar gyis dang po'i sbyor ba sgrub thabs ltar rdzogs par byas/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po sogs nas rten dang brten pa bskyed/ drangs/ phyag rgya bzhis rgyas gdab pa dang*/ mchod cing bstod pa dang*/ bzlas pa rdzogs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin byas/ de nas oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= kṣuṃ= i= dri la sogs pa lngas mchod/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gnas gsum du gtug cing*/ oṃ badzra kā ya hoḥ.oṃ badzra wkkā āḥ.oṃ badzra hṛ da ya hūm̐/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ badzra shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shuddhāḥsarba dhārmā yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ ces dag pa gsum brjod/ de ni bdag nyid mngon par byang chub pas rol pa'i cho ga'o// de nas dkyil 'khor dang bum pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ dkyil 'khor dang bum pa rnams mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor nag po zla gam/ de'i steng du kṣuṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum/ de'i steng du suṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi/ de'i steng du kṣuṃ las 'o ma'i rgya mtsho dang bcas pa'i dbus su hūm̐ suṃ hūm̐ las rin po che sna bdun gyi ri rab/ de'i steng du oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ lag pa rdo rje rtse lnga par bsams nas sa'i gnas lngar brdabs pas/ sna tshogs rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba dang drwa ba dang bcas pa'i gur/ de'i nang du oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ gnas lngar lag pa brdabs pas/ dur khrod kyis bskor ba'i rin po che sna bdun gyi gzhal yas khang gru bzh-i sgo bzhir twa ra ṇa bzhi seng ge rma bya ngang pa chu srin rnams kyis brgyan pa'i rgyal mtshan/

snam bu kha khyer drwa ba drwa phyed ba ku lā dang mda' yab grwa dang mtshams zla ba rdo rjes mtshan pa/ dbus su rta babs med pa'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi nang re'u mig dgu pa/ de'i phyi rol na rdo rje'i 'phreng bas dang*/ phyir rim pa lngas bskor ba'i zlum po/ dbus su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor seng ge'i gdan pad nyi'i steng gdugs dkar po dang ldan pa/ re'u mig gi shar du glang po/ byang du rma bya/ nub tu khyung*/ lhor kiṅka ra/ dbang ldan du seng ge /mer rdo rje'i phag mchu/ bden bral du ma he/ rlung du spyang ki /sgo bzhir ro/ gzhan lha gnas thams cad du pad zla/ dbus su nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de'i steng du a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ'i yi ge las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de gnyis kyi bar du hūm̐ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes las rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa mnyam nyid ye shes/ rdo rje las 'od zer de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang ldan pa byung ste des 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad du sems can gyi don byas slar de nyid la zhugs pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ zla ba rdo rje sa bon dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las rnal 'byor nam mkha' sku mdog sngon po rtsa ba'i zhal khro ba/ g.yas zhal dkar po bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar po sgeg pa/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs sgrog cing spyan gsum gsum pa/ dbu skra zur phud lnga bcings pa la nor bu dang zla tshes dang sna tshogs rdo rjes spras shing thod pa lnga rdo rjes mtshan pa'i rtse phran dang sangs rgyas lngas brgyan pa/ phyag rgya drug dang sbrul la sogs pa'i rgyan/ na bza' dmar po dang stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs rgyab tu cung zad bsnyil ba/ phyag drug gi dang po gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud cing lhag ma'i g.yas gnyis shes rab kyi nu ma dang mda'/

g.yon gnyis padma'i snod dang gzhu 'dzin pa/ dpag tu med pa'i 'od zer 'phro zhing sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis seng ge'i steng sna tshogs padma dang nyi ma la bzhugs pa/ de'i phang du yum ye shes dbang phyug ma dkar mo shin tu mdzes pa kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bsnams pa'i phyag gis yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing ma mchu tshems kyis 'debs pa/ zhabs gnyis kyis sku bcings shing rdo rje padmar thim pa/ lha mo'i rgyan thams cad dang mdzes pa'i gos can/ phyogs bzhir suṃ kṣuṃ yuṃ hūm̐/ mtshams bzhir saṃmarayu haṃmarayu yaṃmarayu kṣaṃmarayu/ sgor phuṃ pheṃ phroṃ phreṃ/ zlum pa'i phyogs su oṃ ho hri hri hri/ kṣ+ri gha gha gha/ ku ru ku ru ku ru/ bhattu li hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mtshams su hūm̐ hūm̐ priṃ/ hūm̐ hoḥpri hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐/ kaṃ kaṃ/ khaṃ khaṃ/ gaṃ gaṃ/ ghaṃ ghaṃ/ tsaṃ tsaṃ/ tshaṃ tshaṃ/ dzaṃ dzaṃ/ taṃ tiṃ/ thiṃ thaṃ/ dzñaṃ dhi/ daṃ daṃ/ diṃ diṃ/ piṃ peṃ/ pheṃ pheṃ/ baṃ baṃ/ biṃ baṃ/ phyi'i sgo bzhir/ khe laṃ baṃ/ oṃ baṃ saṃ/ paṃ maṃ gaṃ/ maṃ oṃ tiṃ/ grwar/ iṃ saṃ ṛ/ kuṃ ba haṃ/ bruṃ laṃ raṃ/ bhur bhuḥbaḥbaṃ uṃ rnams rim pa bzhin yongs su gyur pa las/ re'u mig gi shar du glang po che'i rgyal po la rol pas gnas pa'i rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo/ byang du rma bya la skyil krung phyed pas gnas pa'i drag mo'i mkha' 'gro ma ser mo sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ nub tu bya khyung la tsog pur gnas pa'i ro langs mkha' 'gro ma dmar mo/ lhor kiṅka ra'i gdan la pus mo'i skyil krung gis gnas pa'i gtum mo'i mkha' 'gro ma sngon mo dbu skra bkram pa grol zhing spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ lha mo bzhi ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ glang po che'i pags pas smad/ mi'i zhing gis stod g.yogs pa/ dbang ldan du seng ge la rol pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i seng ge ma g.yas ser g.yon dkar ba/

g.yas kha ṭwāṃ ga 'phyar ba/ mer rdo rje phag mchu la zlum po'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i stag mo g.yas dkar g.yon nag pa/ g.yas lcags kyu 'phyar ba/ srin por ma he la skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i ce spyang ma g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ g.yas dgra st+wa 'phyar ba/ rlung du ce spyang la tsog pu'i stabs kyis gnas pa'i 'ug pa ma g.yas dmar g.yon ser ba/ g.yas dbyug pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon thams cad thugs kar zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ shar gyi sgo ma mkha' 'gro ma dkar mo phyag gnyis kyi rtse mo khar bcug pa/ byang gi sgo ma mar me ma ser mo spyi bor thal mo sbyar ba/ nub kyi sgo ma 'jib byed ma dmar mo snyims pa khrag gis bkang ba zhal du gsol ba/ lho'i sgo ma skam bu 'dzi nag mo thugs kar gtun shing 'dzin ma/ phyi'i zlum po'i shar du pukka sī dang*/ khro gnyer ma dang*/ gtum mo rnams dkar mo phyag na bdud rtsi'i snod/ byang du drag mo dang*/ khrag 'thung ma dang*/ sha za ma rnams ser mo phyag na sha lngas gang ba'i padma'i snod/ nub tu khro mo dang*/ 'bar ma dang*/ 'jigs byed ma rnams dmar mo phyag na gtor snod/ lhod thod 'phreng ma dang*/ rdo rje ma dang*/ bum pa ma rnams nag mo phyag na dam tshig gi zas dang btung ba'i snod 'dzin pa/ grwa bzhi'i dbang ldan du sgeg mo snyems pa'i phyag rgya can dang dri chab ma dri'i snod ser mo/ mer pi waṃ ma pi wang sgreng ba dang me tog ma me tog 'thor ba dkar mo/ bden bral du glu ma kha'i thad kar mdzub mo g.yo ba dang bdug spos ma spos phor nag mo/ rlung du gar ma gar gyi tshul du steng du thal mo sbyar ba dang mar me ma mar me sgreng ba dmar mo/ lha mo de dag thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum dbu skra grol ba/ thod pa lngas brgyan pa'o// de'i phyi'i snam bu'i shar la keng rus 'jigs byed dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga'i srin po dang*/ tshogs kyi dbang phyug dang*/

dril bu'i rna ba can rnams dkar po/ byang du gtum pa'i dbang phyug dang*/ 'dun pa'i lha dang*/ tsha ba'i dbang phyug dang*/ sgra 'jigs byed rnams ser po/ nub tu 'dod pa'i drag po dang*/ ṣa ṇa ḍi la'i dbang phyug dang*/ ḍā ma rus 'dul byed dang*/ rnga sgras 'jigs byed rnams dmar po/ lhor tam bu ra'i dbang phyug dang*/ sthā ḍa ṇa dang*/ mche ba gtsigs pa dang*/ gzhu 'dzin pa rnams nag po chung ma dang bcas pa/ shar gyi sgo ba khyab 'jug nag po/ byang gi sgo ba tshangs pa dmar po/ nub kyi sgo ba lha chen dkar po/ lho'i sgo ba brgya byin ser po/ grwa'i dbang ldan du dbang po ser po/ mer nor lha ku be ra ser skya/ srin por 'byung po'i bdag po gshin rje nag po/ rlung du chu lha wa ru ṇa dkar po rnams chung ma gnyis gnyis dang bcas pa/ de thams cad zhal gcig spyan gsum pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas pa gnyis kha ṭwāṃ ga dang rtse gsum/ g.yon yum la 'khyud pa dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ ral pa nag po'i thor cog can thod 'phreng gis brgyan pa/ phyag rgya lnga dang ldan pa stag gi sham thabs can/ rdzogs pa chen pos skad cig gis bskyed par bya'o// de nas mdun du me tog dkar po 'o ma dang bcas pa'i dri chu gser la sogs pa'i snod du blug pa'i khar me long dri ma med pa bzhag ste/ nam mkha'i khams kun tu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdul phra rab kyi gzugs kyis sems can gyi don mdzad par brtson pa rnams/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ sngags rgyas ye shes pa dang*/ oṃ a karṣa ni hūm̐ dzaḥ sa 'jig rten pa spyan drangs/ oṃ tiṣṭha ā sa na hūm̐ swā hā sa gdan bstabs/ oṃ pra wa ra satka rā pra tītstsha swā hā sa zhabs bkru phul/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= kṣuṃ= i= nyer spyod lngas mchod nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ dga' ba'i lus 'di shin tu sprul// rnal 'byor ma ni thams cad khyod// gsang ba bdag gi bcing don du// gsang ba'i rdo rje shin tu bskyod// tshangs pas bsil g.yab g.yob pa dang*// seng ge dag ni sgo dpon te// brgya byin gdugs ni thogs pa yin// 'phrog byed yon tan sgrog par byed// mi'am ci dang drang srong tshogs// bkra shis glu ni len pa'o//

zhes bstod/ de nas bum pa'i dung chos kyi nang du/ oṃ tapte tapte ma hā tapte hūm̐ swā hā/ bzlas/ gadgā'i chu bkug /g.yon ba dan gsum rgyas de la reg nas/ oṃ suṃ kṣuṃ yuṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ de nas rol mo dang bcas pas/ rgyal ba'i sku la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus kyi sgrib pa dag gyur cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣekka te sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ rgyal ba'i gsung= /sems can ngag= sogs gong ltar/ rgyal ba'i thugs= /sems can yid= / sogs gong ltar/ 'dag chal gyis bkru/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis chu des bkru/ de dag sku la sogs/ oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ sogs kyis dar gyis phyi/ de nas steng du rol pas bzhugs pa la/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ na bza' phul/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ pra wa ra satka ra pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= kṣuṃ= i= yon chab sogs mchod pa phul/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings te mdzub mo gnyis lcags sgrog ltar sbrel la/ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi nang du lha so so'i gdan la bkug oṃ saṃmarayu/ seng ge ma'i sngags rgyas bgegs bskrad la/ oṃ badzra spho ṭa baṃ/ sgo bcing*/ de nas thal mo sbyar nas padma'i tshul du kha bye ba ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgyas/ oṃ tiṣṭha ā sa na hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas lha thams cad gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ gnyis pa ni/ lha rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa zhes sogs nas/ oṃ ghurṇi taṃ hūm̐ phaṭ/ g.yon pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya ste de dag ni phyag rgya chen po'o// zhes pa'i bar dam rgya/ chos rgya/ las rgya/ phyag chen ste phyag rgya bzhis rgyas btab pa sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor bsrung ba bzhin/
