rkang stabs brgyad bsrung ba brgyad de ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas gtug cing*/ spyi bor kṣuṃ/ mig gnyis la hūm̐/ rna ba gnyis dang sna la yuṃ/ lce la suṃ/ mgrin par saṃmarayu/ dpung pa gnyis la haṃmarayu/ snying gar yaṃmarayu/ lte bar kṣaṃmarayu rnams kyis bsrung bar gyur/ yang phyag rgya de nyid spyi bo sogs su gtug cing*/ oṃ badzra kā ya hoḥ oṃ badzra wākkā āḥ oṃ badzra tsitta hūm̐/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje bsdams pa la gung mo gnyis brkyang ste/ rtse gsum pa'i tshigs gsum par mdzub mo gnyis bkug nas sbyar ba spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas lngar bzhag ste/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes pas spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog /dpral bar mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon/ rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin/ ltag par snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin/ rna ltag g.yon du don yod grub pa ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing mdzes pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pas dbang bskur ba dang ldan par gyur/ gzhan lha thams cad kyi cod pan la rnal 'byor nam mkha' rigs kyi bdag por gnas pas rgyas gdab par gyur/ rdo rje khu tshur gyis mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng ba bzlog nas rtse sprad de snying ga dang ltag pa dang dpral bar reg cing*/ oṃ ṭuṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gnas gsum du rdo rje mdud pa bcing*/ phyag rgya de nyid dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa rna ltag gnyis su dar dpyangs bcing*/ sor mo'i rtse sprad la mthil lan gsum du brdab cing*/ oṃ badzra tuṣya hoḥ zhes pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga mnyes par bya/ de nas mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ saṃ shwa dho na hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyer gcig dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lan bdun gyis bsang gtor byas la/ rgyud las 'byung ba bzhin gyi chu gsum 'bul ba ni/

dri med yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i chu// bdud rtsi lnga dang 'o ma legs sbyar zhing*// tsandan la sogs dri zhim gyis bgos pa'i// bsang gtor dam pa gus pa'i blo yis 'bul// mtheb mdzub kyis 'thor g.yab bzung ste 'thor ba'i tshul gyis/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lha yi chu bo ga pur rgyun lta bu// sbrang rtsi ltar dngar ro bcud phun tshogs ldan// yid 'ong dri bsung rmad du byung ba yi// mchod yon dam pa sogs/ de nyid kyi phyag rgya dang*/ rdo rje thal mos dung gi chu bzed zhal du sbreng la/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag pa'i sku// gtsang byed rkyen la nam yang ltos min kyang*// rang gzhan rgyud kyi dri ma sbyang ba'i phyir// zhabs bsil dam pa= / de nyid kyi phyag rgyas/ oṃ pra wa ra satkā ra pra tītstsha swā hā/

nyer spyod dang po nang gi nyer spyod lnga ni/ lus la rjes su chags dang khong khro ba// mnyam nyid sems kyi byug pa thob slad du// mchog tu tshims byed dri chab bzang po yis// dkyil 'khor lha rnams ma lus mchod par bya/ oṃ pra tītstsha su gandhe hūm̐ swā hā/ mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan gyis mdzes gyur pa// bzod pa'i sa bon las byung me tog gis// rnam pa kun tu spras pa'i sku 'grub phyir// kha dog dri ldan phul byung me tog gis// dkyil 'khor= oṃ puṣpe mā le hūm̐ swā hā/ chos rnams mnyam pa nyid du sgom pa las// rang bzhin dag pa'i bdug pas tshims byed slad// lha rdzas spos mchog ji snyed mchis pa yis// dkyil 'khor= /oṃ dhu pe shwa ri hūm̐ swā hā/ shes rab mar me'i snang ba bzang po yis// khams gsum kun gyi mun pa rab bcom nas// ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du snang bya'i phyir// rin chen sgron me'i phreng ba bstar byas nas// dkyil 'khor= /oṃ tīkṣ+ṇa dī pe hūm̐ swā hā/ 'gro la mi 'jigs sbyin pa la sogs kyis// dbugs ma phyin pa dag ni dbugs dbyung zhing*// bsam gtan zas kyi dga' ston spel slad du// zhal zas bza' btung ro brgya ldan pa yis// dkyil 'khor= /oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā ba liṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes rgyud las gsungs pa'i dag pa dang sbyar ba so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ tshangs pa'i dbyangs kyis dam chos ston pa dang*// mi shigs gzhom du med pa'i sgra sgrog phyir// sil snyan rnam pa sna tshogs sgra 'byin pas// dkyil 'khor= /oṃ badzra ghāṇḍā ra ṇi ta sogs kyi sngags brjod cing rol mo bya'o// nyer spyod gnyis pa phyi'i nyer spyod ni/ legs par sbyar dang yongs gyur pa'i// dri bzang rnam pa sna tshogs kyi// phye ma rnams dang dri chab dag /ting nge 'dzin gyis spel byas te// bdag gzhan sbyor dang gsang ba yi// gdan bzhi pa yi dkyil 'khor che// gus pa'i blo yis rtag tu mchod// brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzhes su gsol// oṃ pra tītstsha su gandhe hūm̐ swā hā/

shlau ka phyi ma dang rang rang gi sngags rgya so so'i mthar sbyar la/ kha dog lnga ldan padma ni// 'dab ma stong phrag rgyas pa dang*// utpal la dang ku mu dang*// puṇḍa ri ka la sogs pas/ bdag gzhan= oṃ puṣpe mā le hūm̐ swā hā// lhan cig skyes dang de bzhin du// sbyar ba las byung bye brag gi /bdug spos dri mchog dang ldan pa// 'jig rten 'di na mchis pa kun// bdag gzhan= /oṃ dhu pe shwa ri hūm̐ swā hā// nyi zla nor bu'i 'od rnams dang*// sgron shing 'bru mar mar me sogs// snang byed rnam pa ma lus pa// sangs rgyas zhing rnams gsal byas te// bdag gzhan= /oṃ tīkṣ+ṇa dī pe hūm̐ swā hā// bsod nams stobs las grub pa yi// bdud rtsi kha dog lnga dang ldan// bza' bca' ldag dang gzhibs pa dang*// lha dang mi yi btung ba'i tshogs// bdag gzhan= /oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā ba liṃ hūm̐ swā hā// 'dod gzugs lha mi'i glu dbyangs dang*// rol mo'i rnam pa thams cad pa// bstod dbyangs yan lag kun 'byung ba'i// bsam gtan las byung sgra snyan rnams// bdag gzhan sbyor dang gsang ba= /oṃ badzra ghāṇḍā sogs bya'o// phyag rgya nyi shu sgrub thabs ltar ram rgyas par spro na/ gdangs snyan skad kyi 'gyur ba brgya phrag gis// skye bo'i rna ba'i dbang po tshim byed pa// lha rdzas pi waṃ brdung ba'i tshul gyis ni// bcom ldan rnal 'byor nam mkha' 'khor bcas mchod// lte snying spyi bo'i thad du pad kor byas nas/ rdo rje'i khu tshur dku gnyis su bzhag pa thams cad kyi sngon du bya ba yin la/ bye brag gi phyag rgya so so sgrub thabs ltar byas la/ oṃ āḥbadzra bī ṇi hūm̐/ zhes pa'i mthar g.yon tu bsdu ba thams cad la mtshungs so// mdzes pa'i sor gdub dang bcas lag pa yis// rnam mang 'gyur khug du ma'i sgra dbyangs can// lha rdzas gling bu kun tu bsgyur byas nas// bcom ldan rnal 'byor

sogs rkang pa tha ma kun la sbyar ro/ /oṃ āḥbadzra waṃ she hūm̐/ mtha' yas zhing kun khyab pa'i sgra dang ldan// zab yangs sbub can kunda'i mdangs 'phrog shing*// lha rdzas yid du 'ong ba'i nga ro yis// bcom ldan= oṃ aḥbadzra shaṅkha hūm̐/ mchog tu zlum zhing dbyibs legs kha khyer can// rmad byung skad gsang mthon por sgrogs pa yi// lha rdzas 'khar rnga skul byed kyis brdungs te// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra pa ṇā ba hūm̐/ sos ka'i tsha ba'i gdung ba rab sel zhing*// rnam par bkra zhing nor bu'i yu ba can// lha rdzas rlung g.yab mdzes par g.yob pa yis// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra bi dha mā naṃ hūm̐// rin chen 'bar ba'i tog gis rtse mor spud/ kha dog sna tshogs dar gyi chun 'phyang ldan// lha rdzas rgyal mtshan mngon par bsgreng ba yis// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra dhwa dza hūm̐/ 'khor yug kun tu khyab pa'i sgra sgrogs pa// rol mo'i tshogs kyi sna 'dren pa ṭa ha// lha rdzas rnga chen legs par bsgrags pa yis// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra pa ṭa ha hūm̐/ rdo rje thal mos bskul ba las byung ba'i// snyan zhing 'jam pa'i sgra chen ci yang 'byung*// lha rdzas rnga zlum rab tu brdungs byas te// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra mṛ daṃ ga hūm̐/ dri med rab gtsang las grub la phubs dang*// stong phrag rtsibs bcas gser gyi yu ba can// lha rdzas gdugs mdzes mngon par phub pa yis// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra tstsha traṃ ka hūm̐/ dbang po'i gzhu ltar spel legs sham bu mdzes// rab yangs nam mkha'i rgyan du gyur pa yi// lha rdzas bla bre yongs su bres byas nas// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra bi tā na hūm̐/ gos bzang kha dog gsal ba las grub cing*// phyogs su rnam par bskyod pa'i yan lag can// lha rdzas ba dan kun tu brkyangs byas nas// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra pā taṃ ka hūm̐/ sgeg pa la sogs lus kyi rnam 'gyur dang*// drug las skyes sogs glu yi kyo bar ldan// mig gi dga' ston bskyed pa'i gar rnams kyis// bcom ldan=

/oṃ āḥbadzra daṇḍa pa hūm̐/ rig ma'i mkha' dang sbyor ba'i khyad par las// dga' ba rnam bzhi'i rol par shar ba'i mthus// rgod pa'i rtsed 'jo mchog la gnas pa'i phyir// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra hā sya hūm̐/ zag med lus kyi skye mched ma bsgribs par// lhan skyes bde bas rtag tu gang ba las// rnam par sgeg pa'i nyams dang ldan pa yis// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra shriṅga la hūm̐/ kun tu 'phyan pa'i nyon mongs rtog pa ni// yul la rjes chags 'ben rnams 'bigs byed pa// khro bo'i dbang phyug rtse ba'i mda' 'phen pas// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra bī bhat+sa hūm̐/ ma rungs gdug pa'i tshogs rnams gzhom slad du// drag shul chen po'i rnal 'byor la gnas nas// bdud sde'i dpung rnams ma lus dngangs byas te// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra rau draṃ hūm̐/ mi bzad sdang ba'i sems kyis kun 'khrugs pa'i// nag po'i rtsa lag mtha' dag 'jigs mdzad pa// 'jigs rung dpa' bo'i mtshan ma bstan nas kyang*// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra bha ya na ka hūm̐/ lha mo'i ta na yid 'ong rgyas shing 'khrang*// dam du 'tshir ba las byung snying rje'i nyams// bde stong ro mnyam shin tu 'phel bya'i phyir// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra kā ru ṇa hūm̐/ lus rgyan kun gyi dri ma med pa'i khams// sems dpa' mchog gis mngon par rtogs pa'i gnas// rgyun mi 'chad pa'i de nyid mtshon byed pas// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra satwa shwa ta hūm̐/ rmad byung 'khor lo'i bdag po 'khor bcas la// mi 'phrog dang bas spyi bos phyag 'tshal zhing*// gus pas thal mo sbyar ba'i 'dud tshul gyis// bcom ldan= /oṃ āḥbadzra ātabhu taṃ hūm̐// zhes pa rnams so/ /sgeg sogs lha mo nam mkha' gang ba rnams kyis mchod par bltas la/ lta bas mi ngoms mdzes pa'i gzugs// zla ba'i 'od ltar gsal ba'i mdog /snyems tshul khu tshur dkur 'dzin ma// rdo rje sgeg mos lha rnams mchod//

phyag rgya brgyad so so dam rgya ltar byas la/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ dri za'i glu dbyangs zil gnon ma// rgyud mangs sgreng mkhan 'jo sgeg ma// dung ltar dkar zhing rgyan gyis bklubs// pi waṃ 'dzin mas lha rnams mchod/ oṃ hūm̐ hoḥswā hā/ lha mo stong zil kha dog can// drug ldan la sogs glu len zhing*// gdangs snyan mdzub mo bskul la brtson// glu len ma yis lha rnams mchod// oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ mdzes pa'i phyag gnyis gar byed cing*// rol pa'i lus kyi rnam 'gyur can// lha mo thun mtshams sprin gyi mdog /gar sgyur ma yis lha rnams mchod// oṃ su nṛ ti hūm̐ swā hā/ sna tshogs dri yi snod 'dzin cing*// rdo rje'i thal mos byug pa'i tshul// btso ma'i gser gyi mdangs chags pa'i// dri chab ma yis lha rnams mchod// oṃ su gandhe hūm̐ swā hā/ sku mdog mig sman ltar gnag cing*// rin chen padma 'dab brgyad pa// char bzhin rab tu 'bebs mdzad ma// me tog ma yis lha rnams mchod// oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ nyi ma 'char kha bzhin du dmar// phyag gnyis lha rdzas spos snod nas// dri bzang zhing kun khyab par spro// bdug spos 'dzin mas lha rnams mchod// oṃ āḥswā hā/ karke ta ltar sku mdog ser// nor bu'i sgron me 'bar ba 'dzin// stong gsum mtha' dag snang bar byed// mar me ma yis lha rnams mchod// oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā// zhes so/ gos zung khu tshur gnyis brkyang ste bzung la/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi shigs rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lha rnams la phul ba'i mos pa bya'o/ /dpal gyi 'bras bu'am gzhan yang rung*// 'bras bu sna tshogs dbul bar bya// nyi ma zla ba kha sbyar te// 'bras bu'i tshul du byas la dbul// snyim pa sbyar te/ oṃ dzruṃ swā hā

sa 'bras bu phul// de nas lcags kyu lnga'i bza' ba/ oṃ priṃ ghruṃ dzraṃ a swā hā sa byin gyis brlab/ lcags kyu lnga la sogs pa dag /de bzhin de nyid rig pas dbul// bza' dang bca' ba sna tshogs pa// kun nas thams cad dbul bar bya// lcags kyu gzhan ni thams cad kyang*// lcags kyu lnga yi de nyid bya// thams cad rig pas phyi nang gi// rnal 'byor ma kun dbul bar bya/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ghuṃ ghuṃ/ oṃ pheṃ ghuṃ phuṃ ghuṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ gtor ma bzhin gyi phyag rgya bcas te phul/ de nas me tog dkar po/ bdug spos/ sa lu'i zan/ zho/ bu ram/ sbrang rtsir bsres pa'i gtor mas dbang ldan nas dang*/ chang gi snod/ lha bshos/ nya dang*/ sha sna tshogs dang*/ sran/ zan/ til/ 'khur ba la sogs pa bza' ba bden bral/ zho dang*/ mar/ sbrang rtsi/ mar khu bza' ba zhim por bcas pas me mtshams/ dri me tog bdug pa mar me sna tshogs kyi mchod pa/ me tog dkar sogs bdug pa dang*// 'o ma'i snod ni rgya cher bcas// lha bshos sna tshogs mchod pa ni// rlung gi mtshams su dbul bar bya// nya dang sha sogs sran chan khrag /snod ni yongs su bkang nas su// til khur la sogs bza' dang bca'// bden bral du ni dbul bar bya// zho dang sbrang rtsi mar du bsre// bza' ba zhim por bcas pa dag /blo dang ldan pas me mtshams su// khyad par du ni dbul bar bya// dri dang me tog rgya chen dang*// bdug spos mar me rgya chen dang*// gtor ma'i mchod pa rgya chen rnams// dad dang ldan pa gnas nas dbul// phyag rgya dang bshad ma thag pa'i sngags/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ghuṃ ghuṃ/ oṃ pheṃ ghuṃ phuṃ ghuṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes phul/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= kṣuṃ= i= dri la sogs pa'i sngags rgyas 'bul lo/ /mdzes pa'i rdo rje gsor byas nas// thams cad mya ngan 'das par dgrol// chos kyi rnam par dag byed pa// rdo rje snying po 'dzin par bya//

zhes pas lha sum cu'i bdag nyid can gyi rdo rje thabs kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pas lag pa g.yas pas bzung*/ hūm̐ zhes lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi bdag nyid can gyi dril bu shes rab kyi rtogs pa dang ldan pas g.yon pas bzung*/ khu tshur rgyab sprad mthe'u chung sbrel nas/ oṃ badzra ghaṇḍa ra ni ta pra ra ni te/ sarba buddha pra tsa li te pradzña pā ra mi tā nā da swa bha be nan/ sarba bud dha hri da ya a wa to ṣi ṇi hāṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swā hā/ de nas rdo rje gsor dril bu 'khrol zhing sgeg cing rgod pas hūm̐ glur len mda' gzhu la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bcings te/ sems dpa' chen po dang po mchog /dga' ba chen po dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun gyi bdag /rdo rje snying po gtso bo'i gtso// thugs kyi sems dpa' ting 'dzin mchog /rdo rje rdo rje chen po'i stobs// kun tu bzang po spyod pa'i stobs// bdud dang bdud ni rab 'joms pa// kun gyi khro bo khro chen po// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas chos skyes mchog /rdo rje hūm̐ byed hūm̐ byed pa// 'jig rten dbang phyug nor bu sbyin// chags pa chen po bde ba che// 'dod pa thar pa don chen po// srid gsum 'jig rten nor gyi mchog /'jig rten gsum mchog khams gsum la// mi g.yo rab mchog mi gsal ba// shin tu phra dang rags 'dus pa// g.yo dang rab mchog thob pa yi// srid dang 'khor ba dag byed pa// thog ma med pa mtha' med pa// thog ma mtha' dang sngon phyi dang*// thams cad du ni yang dag gnas// snying po phyag rgya dam tshig sbyor// de bzhin nyid sems mchod pa che// rdo rje khro bo khro chen po// 'jigs pa'i 'bar ba 'dul byed pa// sdang ba chen po mchog tu 'dul// mi bzad drag po'i 'jigs byed pa// de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa che// chos dang las dang che ba'i mchog /dam pa'i chos dang las gyi lam// byang chub sems ni rgyas par byed// kun gyi dag pa padma che// thabs dang shes rab nor che ba// 'dod chags dag pa ting 'dzin mchog

/sna tshogs 'dod chags dbang phyug che// nam mkha' mtha' yas rtag pa'i don// 'byung ba chen po kun gyi gzhi// longs spyod dpal gyi rgyal po gtso// 'dod pa thams cad rdzogs byed pa// phyag 'tshal bstod de phyag 'tshal bstod// gus pas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje sems dpa' de dag 'grub/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ 'khor ba mchog gi sku 'dzin pa// phan tshun 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba 'chang*// rdo rje 'dzin pa te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ zhabs mchog lha mchog gis btud pa// me tog las sprul 'phro dang bcas// kyai/ rdo rje khyod ni te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ dngos las grol ba'i don gyi phyir// gsang ba nges par 'ching mdzad pa// rol cig rol cig rdo rje khyod// gsang ba gzigs pa'i dgongs pa mdzad/ te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ rin thang med pa'i bdud rtsi yis// sems can rnams ni khyod kyis bkrus// bdag ni 'khor ba las sgrol ba// khyod la gus dang bcas pas 'dud// te na hūm̐/ te na te te hūm̐/ glang chen mchog gi steng bzhugs pa// sku ni dung ltar dkar bas mdzes// mtha' yas dung gis brgyan pa'i sku// shar gtso rdo rje ma la 'dud// gser gyi mchog ltar mdzes pa'i sku// shin tu drag po sbrul gyis brgyan// mdzes pa'i zas gang thod pa can// byang gi lha mo rgyal gyur cig /padma dmar ltar mdzes pa'i sku// hūm̐ gi nga ro 'jigs par mdzad// drag po dbyug pa thod pa bsnams// nub kyi lha mo gtso la 'dud// 'od zer dra ba sngon pos mdzes// seng ge 'phrog byed tshangs dbang gtso// bdud 'dul phyir ni khro gzugs 'dzin// hūm̐ mdzad lho yi lha mor 'dud// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ sangs rgyas lnga yi mkha' 'gro ma// lnga lnga rnam par dag pa'o// rnal 'byor ma kun de nyid sprul// stong dang stong min 'khor ba'i dngos// dngos dang dngos med grol ba nyid// de 'dra'i sku ni dbus bzhugs nas// rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs kyis bskor// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma yi sku// dkyil 'khor bye ba de yis mnyes// glu sogs chags pa'i rang bzhin nyid// bza' dang bza' min sngon nas spangs// dang po yi ni rdo rje yis// padma la ni bskyod par mdzad// bdud rtsi lnga yis bdag la bkrus// lcags kyu gsol ba'i sbyor ba bsten// bzhengs shig kha sbyor sbyor ba mdzod// dam chos snying po rgyas mdzad pa// dam chos thar pa gtso bo'i gtso// yang dag rgyal ba 'khor ba spangs// dkyil 'khor spro bas 'gro bar sgrol// bdud gsol seng ge ma yi sku// stag mos shin tu skrag par mdzad// 'ug pa'i sgra yis yid skrag cing*// phai phaiṃ sgrog pas sdang lus gzigs// dpa' bo rdo rje khyod la 'dud// 'khor ba sgrol ba khyod la 'dud// gsang bas bdud rtsi gsol la 'dud// gus dang bcas par phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan de nyid rgyal po dam pa dbang phyug spyi gzugs kyi// dpal ldan gsang ba'i gdan mchog 'od zer rab 'bar ba// dpal ldan rdo rje dril bu dkrol sbyor de bzhin nyid// dpal ldan ye shes brtan pa'i dbang phyug longs spyod 'dud//

ces sna tshogs pa'i glus bstod/ oṃ shuddhe dharme hūm̐/ a āḥ.a/ oṃ swā hā/ zhes bstod pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// gsum pa la bzlas pa/ oṃ hūm̐ haḥswā hā/ gtso bo yab yum la brgya rtsa brgyad/ gzhan rnams bdun res bsnyen/ lha 'od du zhu ba'i bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi chur gyur/ rang nyid rgyan gos gsar pas dkyil 'khor kyi shar sgor rol pa'i stabs kyis rol mor bcas pa tsan dan dkar pos gru bzhir byugs pa tsan dan dkar po gcal du bkram/ dri dang me tog bdug pa mar me sā lu'i 'bras/ zan zho bu ram 'o thug gi snod bzhag brgya byin gdugs ni thogs pa dang*// tshangs pas bsil yab g.yob pa dang*// seng ge mdun nas gsol ka ba// 'phrog byed yon tan sgrog par byed// ces bsam zhing*/ oṃ saṃ sho dha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ rdo rje dril bu bzung rdo rje khu tshur bcings nas rgyab sbyar mthe'u chung sbrel/ mdzub mo gnyis sbrel/ g.yas pa cung zad bkug pa'i lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas/ oṃ bha ta li ma hā bha ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā// de nas g.yon snod la reg /g.yas pa rdo rje khu tshur las mdzub mo bsgreng nas/ oṃ/ rgyu ba dang ni cher rgyu ba// yi dwags rgyu ba nyi ma zla// dngos grub gdong dang rgyal ba dang*// rta'i rgyal dang zla ba'i rgyal// lha mo u ma gaṃ gā dang*// gzugs mdzes skar ma bsdus pa dang*// gza' rnams kun dang tshogs kyi gtso// kārti ka dang dpal ldan ma// lha mo ri bong 'dzin ma nyid// lhag pa dang ni lhag pa che// lha yi rgyal po lha min rgyal// pukka sī dang spos chen mo// hūm̐ hoḥhoḥ ā karṣa ya sa ma ya mā ti bhe hūm̐ phaṭ dzaḥswā hā/ spyan drangs nas/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= kṣuṃ= i= mchod pa lngas mchod/ lcags kyu'i rgya las mdzub mo gnyis dkris nas/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa sa ma ya ma a dhi pa ti dzruṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/

zhes lha dang lha min grub pa mnyes par byas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs nas/ /yid la 'dod kun 'grub mdzod// ces 'dod don gsol/ se gol gsum gtog cing*/ oṃ sarba duṣṭa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gatstsha gatstsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshegs su gsol/ de nas byang sgor mnyam pa'i stabs kyis/ dkar pos byugs pa'i maṇḍal zlum po/ 'o ma me tog dkar po sogs/ 'o mar bcas pa'i lha bshos/ oṃ saṃ shodha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ sngar bzhin gyis/ oṃ bha ta li ma hā bha ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ sngags rgya dang g.yon pas khu tshur las mthe bong mthe'u chung brkyang*/ g.yas pa brkyang ste gdengs kar byas nas snod la reg pas/ oṃ/ mtha' yas dang ni nor rgyas bu// 'jog po dang ni stobs kyi rgyu// padma padma chen po dang*// dung skyong dang ni rigs ldan rnams/ lha mo lha mo chen po dang*// zla ba'i spyi gtsug spyi gtsug che// be con 'dzin dang be con che// snying po med dang 'gu li ta// dga' bo dang ni nye dga' dang*// rgya mtsho dang ni rgya mtsho che// gdung ba dang ni gdung chen po// dpal gyi 'od dang 'od po che// rin chen 'od dang gzugs bzang dang*// gzugs chen gzugs bzang lto 'phye che// smig rgyu dang ni smig rgyu che// oṃ ā gatstsha ā gatstsha ma hā nā ga a dhi pa ti sarba bhur bhuḥbaḥphruṃ phaṭ swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā sogs mchod pa lnga dang*/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa sa ma ya ma a dhi pa ti dzruṃ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ klu rnams mnyes par byas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ se gol gsum gtog cing*/ oṃ sarba duṣṭa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gatstsha gatstsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshegs su gsol/ nub tu zlum po'i stabs kyis tsan dan dmar pos/ maṇḍal me tog dmar po bkram pa me tog sogs dang gtor ma bdud rtsi lnga dang ldan pa/ oṃ saṃ sho dha na hūm̐ phaṭa

kyis bsang*/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bha ta li ma hā bha ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ sngags rgyas dang*/ mnyam pa'i rkang stabs bskyod cing*/ oṃ nor bu bzang dang gang ba bzang*// rgyal ba bzang po dga' byed phur// phur bu che dang padma'i gtsug /dung gi gtsug phud gar dang ni// gar chen 'bigs par byed pa dang*// gcod par byed dang gang bar byed// nor dang nor min shin tu nor// gzugs bzang rol pa rol chen po// rgod dang rtsed dang rnam par bskyod// dpal bzang dang ni gzugs mdzes rnams// bde ba chen po'i bka' 'di yis// gnod sbyin gnod sbyin mo 'dir shog /oṃ a ba da ra a ba da ra/ pa ta li pa ta li bhakṣa pri ya/ yo ga ni ma dhe hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā sogs mchod pa lnga dang*/ khu tshur sbyar ba snying gar btsir nas/ oṃ dā na a dhi pa ta ye pa ta li phruṃ swā hā/ zhes gnod sbyin rnams mnyes par byas/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ se gol gsum gtog cing*/ oṃ sarba duṣṭa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gatstsha gatstsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshegs su gsol/ rdo rje'i stabs kyis/ khrag gis byugs pa'i maṇḍal gru gsum me tog dmar po brdal ba gdug pa'i dri sogs dang*/ gtor ma sha nya btsong khrag gis gang ba sran chan til 'khur bdud rtsi lnga la sogs pa bza' ba sna tshogs/ oṃ saṃ sho dha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ bha ta li ma hā bha ta li hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ sngags rgya ḍā ma ru dang bcas/ oṃ/ dur khrod dang ni shing gcig dang*// ri bo dang ni ri sul phug /grong dang gzhi mdo zhing dang ni// khyad par du ni khyim stong dang*// sems can gnas dang thang dang ni// khyad par du ni chu la gnas// nag po chen po drag chen po// lha sbyin mnyam du brten pa dang*// nag po rtsigs dang mi sdug dang*// rga las 'das dang log 'dren dang*// rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang*// 'jigs byed ma dang u ma dang*// rgyal dang rnam par rgyal ma dang*// mi thub gzhan gyis mi thub ma// nag mo bzang mo nag chen mo// nag sbom ma dang rnal 'byor ma// dbang mo dang ni zla ba mo// drag tu sdang dang 'phyang ba mo// 'phrog byed ma dang mar me ma// 'jigs byed grong gnas rnal 'byor ma// drag mo'i gzugs dang gzugs chen mo// mche ba gtsigs dang thod chen mo// thod phreng 'phreng dang kha ṭwāṃ ga

/sbrul chen ral gri dgra st+wa can// rdo rje'i de ni gzhu can ma// de nyid chen mo mkha' 'gro lnga// las kun rjes su sgrub byed pa// sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor rgyal chen mo// de bzhin rdo rje dbang phyug gtso// de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen mo// rdul med rnal 'byor sbyin pa mo// rdo rje dbang mo'i bka' 'di yis// thams cad ma lus 'dir 'dus shig /oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma ya a dhi pa ti hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= kṣuṃ= i= mchod pa lngas mchod/ oṃ bhakṣa bhakṣa sarba yo ga yo gi shwa ri hūm̐ hūm̐ dzaḥdzaḥswā hā/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis 'dod don gsol/ se gol gsum gtog cing*/ oṃ sarba duṣṭa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gatstsha gatstsha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshegs su gsol/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar ram byang du cho ga rdzogs par byas nas/ de nas lha rnams tshim par byed pa'i phyir/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar ram byang nub tu zhi rgyas kyi thab rgyar sor bcu bzhi pa/ phyi rol gru bzhi/ de'i cha gnyis brkos sam 'bur du dod pa brtsigs pa/ kha khyer de'i bzhi cha/ mu ran padma 'dab brgyad kha khyer gyi phyed tshad/ phyi rol gyi ra ba sor gcig pa zhi ba zlum po/ rgyas pa gru bzhi/ nang gi dbus su padma'i lte bar rdo rje sangs rgyas bzhi'i mtshan ma 'dab mar/ grwa dbang po'i rdo rjes brgyan pa/ dgang gzar sogs yo byad tshang bar bsag /mchod pa dang sreg rdzas / oṃ saṃ shwa dha ni hūm̐ phaṭ/ kyis bsangs/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lan bdun gyis/ mchod rdzas rnams hūm̐ yig las byung ba'i ye shes kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ zhes mchod rdzas byis gyis brlabs/ oṃ swā hā sa rdzas bkru/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ yam shing*/ oṃ shrīḥswā hā/ zhun mar/ oṃ dziṃ? swā hā/ 'bru rnams/ oṃ ku ru ku ru swā hā/ rdzas gzhan rnams/ sreg rdzas rnams ngo bo ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnam pa las mthun gyi nus pa dang ldan pa'i lha rdzas kyi yo byad so sor

bsam nas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas ku sha bsangs/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa la skyes pa 'dab ma'i snying*// dkon mchog gsum po mnyes byed cing*// tshangs pa lha yi dag byed yin// bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang*/ rgyas pa yin na/ phun tshogs rgyas par mdzad du gsol// oṃ badzra satwa āḥ zhes brjod cing g.yas bskor du bkram/ thab bsangs/ stong pa'i ngang las bhrūṃ yig dkar po yongs su gyur pa las/ zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po 'am/ rgyas pa'i thab khung ser po gru bzhi pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ rgya'i phyed kyi zab dang ldan pa/ mchu dang kha khyer sogs mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa gsal bar gyur/ ces thab bskyed/ zhi ba la bram ze'am/ dge 'dun gyi tshang mang ngam/ rtsub shing las byung ba dang*/ rgyas pa la rgyal po'am/ phyug po'i khyim mam/ me shel las byung ba'i me sbar te/ oṃ dzwa la dzwa la hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ oṃ hūṃ swā hā 'am/ oṃ trāṃ swā hā/ brjod pas rlung g.yob/ zhi ba la hūm̐ dang*/ rgyas pa la bhrūṃ brjod pa bdun gyis dgang blug gis mar khu blugs/ de nas/ thab kyi me yi dbus su paṃ las padma dang*/ raṃ las nyi ma'i gdan la raṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ drang srong me lha sku mdog dkar po 'am/ ser po/ shin tu zhi zhing mdzes pa 'am/ sgeg cing bzhad pa/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ thor tshugs dang smar smin sogs drang srong gi nyam dang ldan pa/ dar dkar po'i 'am/ ser po'i na bza' dang*/ chu shel sogs sam/ nor bu sogs rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing bgrang phreng dang spyil blug 'dzin pa/ zhabs sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa mi bskyod pas sam/ rin 'byung gis dbu brgyan pa/ me'i khams kyi rang bzhin can du gsal bar gyur/ ces 'jig rten pa bskyed/ de'i spyi bor oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐ dang raṃ yig gis mtshan pa sa byin gyis brlabs/

bdag gi thugs ka'i 'od kyis 'jig rten gyi khams shar lho'i phyogs nas me lha ye shes pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs par bsam la/ oṃ/ gzi brjid chen po me yi lha// las kyi don kun 'grub pa po// snying rjes sems can don mdzad nas// 'di nyid du ni nye bar mdzod// oṃ ā gatstsha ya ā gatstsha ya agne dzaḥswā hā/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ las sngags kyis phyir 'brang gi bgegs bskrad/ mchod yon sbreng la/ oṃ pra titstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil 'bul la/ oṃ pra wa ra satkā ra pra titstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang dbyer med du gyur/ de nas byon skyems 'bul ba la/ me lha cung zad zhal gdang ba'i ljags dang dgang gzar gyi khar hūm̐ gis mtshan par bsam/ oṃ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ agnā ye swā hā/ zhes byang chub mchog gi khu tshur gyis lan bdun dang*/ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ oṃ agnā ye sa dha ka sya sarba pā paṃ shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes sam/ rgyas par sngags gong ltar la/ sarba puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes brjod pa lan gsum du 'bul/ de nas/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= hūm̐= i= zhes nyer spyod kyis mchod/ de nas pad dkor dang bcas pas/ oṃ dzu hu dzu hu agnā ye swā hā/ zhes pas yam shing*/ mar sbrang 'o mar bcas pa/ 'bru sna/ 'o thug sā lu'i 'bras/ zan mar 'o mar bcas pa/ slar mar dang 'o mar bcas pa/ mar dang bdud rtsi lnga ste sreg rdzas rnams so sor grangs ji ltar rigs pa sngags des phul la/ spel tshig bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe 'di dang phyi ma'i legs pa'i tshogs la bar du gcod pa thams cad sarba pā paṃ shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod/ rgyas pa la/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po'i tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa thams cad puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes brjod/ oṃ/ tshangs pa 'jig rten mgon gyi sras// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /'byung po yongs su skyabs pa'i phyir// thugs rje'i dbang gis skur sprul pa// nyes pa'i skyon bral tshangs par spyod// 'jig rten gnas kyang mya ngan 'das// zhi ba brnyes kyang thugs rje che// de la bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal//

ces bstod/ de nas/ oṃ agnā ye swā hā/ zhes dgang blug lan gsum phul la/ me lha me phung 'bar ba'i gzugs kyi rnam par ro gcig tu gyur pa'i dbus su dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha yi grangs dang mnyam pa'i padma'i gdan la mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor nas lha rnams gsal zhing rdzogs par spyan drangs/ oṃ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ zhes pa'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs pa rnams la/ oṃ tiṣṭha a sa na hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas phul ba'i gdan la/ dkyil 'khor gyi go rim ji lta bar 'khod par bsam/ mchod yon sbreng la/ oṃ pra titstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil phul la/ oṃ pra wa ra satkā ra pra titstsha swā hā/ gtso 'khor rnams cung zad zhal gdang la ljags dang dgang gzar gyi khar hūm̐ yig gis mtshan par bsam la/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ bdun gyis dgang ba'i mar khu/ oṃ ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥswā hā sa 'bul/ oṃ na maḥs manta buddha nāṃ sa dha ka sya sarba pā paṃ shantiṃ ku ru swā hā/ ces sam/ sngags de la/ sarba puṣṭiṃ ku ru oṃ/ zhes lan gsum gyi byon skyems phul/ de nas/ oṃ pra titstsha su gandhe hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ puṣpe mā le hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ dhū pe shwa ri hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ tīkṣ+ṇa dī pe hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ ku ru ku ru ma hā ba liṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes nyer spyod lnga dang*/ oṃ badzra lā sya hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra gandhe hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra wi ṇi hūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra puṣpe= oṃ badzra girti= oṃ badzra dhū pe= oṃ badzra nṛ tya= oṃ badzra dī pe hūm̐ swā hā/ ces sgegs sogs brgyad dang*/ spro na/ pi wang tshul gyis bsgreng ba dang*// sogs mchod pa nyi shus kyang mchod/ de nas ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas yaṃ shing mar sbrang 'o mar bcas pa/ 'bru rnams/ 'o thug sā lu'i 'bras/ zan mar 'o mar bcas pa rnams/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags kyis 'bul zhing*/ ṭhaḥṭhaḥ 'i sngags gsum dang*/ 'dod gsol gong ltar sbyar/

de ltar rdzas rnams so so bzhin phul/ slar mar dang 'o mar bcas pa/ mar dang bdud rtsi lnga rnams kyang de ltar phul/ rgyas pa la'ang 'dod gsol gyi khyad par tsam mo/ de nas rdo rje gsor zhing dril bu 'khrol bas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ yang dag spro dang sdud pa po// bdag med rnal 'byor ston mdzad pa/ thun mong rnal 'byor bdag nyid de// rnam par snang mdzad phyag 'tshal bstod// hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ stong pa'i de nyid la sogs pa'i// de nyid rgyu las gzugs su bstan// gang dag 'dod bzhin gyur pa'i dngos// ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod//

ces bstod/ de nas/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= hūm̐= i= zhes nyer spyod dang*/ sgegs sogs brgyad kyi sngags bcas phyi nang gi mchod pa phul/ gtor ma/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥswā hā sa byin gyis rlabs/ oṃ ku ru ku ru mahā batta li hūm̐ swā hā/ rang rgya bcas lan gsum gyis phul/ mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la// sogs kyis 'phrin las bcol/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pas mar khu'i dgang blug byon skyems skabs ltar phul/ slar lha rnams dkyil 'khor du gshegs nas de nyid du so so'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam la/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ shrīṃ= iṃ= hūm̐= i= rnams kyi sngags rgyas mchod/ de nas slar me kha gso zhing*/ oṃ saṃ shwa dha nī hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bsang gtor byas la/ de nyid du/ slar yang me lha 'bar ba'i rnam pa las sngar bzhin bzhengs par bsam pa'i 'jig rten pa la/ oṃ dzu hu dzu hu agnā ye swā hā/ zhes yaṃ shing sogs rdzas lhag ma rnams sngar bzhin phul/ gong gi dkyil 'khor skabs ltar gtor ma 'bul zhing 'dod gsol bya/ nyer spyod kyis mchod/ dgang blug lan gsum byon skyems skabs ltar phul/ oṃ badzra gaṇḍa ra ni ta nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho aṃ swā hā 'i bar rdo rje dril bu de nyid kyi sngags rgya bya'o// de nas lcags kyu lnga'i bza' ba/ oṃ priṃ ghrūṃ dzaṃ a swā hā/ zhes gtor ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas phul/ bdud rtsi lnga'i btung ba/ oṃ hūm̐ haḥswā hā/ zhes phul/ gtor ma/ oṃ ku ru ku ru mahā ba liṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes dang*/ thal mo sbyar ba gsang ba'i thad du bzhag nas/ mthe'u chung bskyod pa ā li'i phyag rgya bzhin gyis/ oṃ āḥswā hā/ zhes phul/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rdo rje sems dpa' bsam pas rol// thar pa la dgyes lta na yang*// shin tu dbyer med rtag pa ste// sha dang sbrang rtsi bsrubs mthu yis// rdo rje ma gcig ngal ba 'joms// drag mo ro langs gtum mo yis// bya ba sna tshogs byed 'gyur gtso// yongs su grol ba'i mchod nyid de// thar dang 'gal la snying rje khro// snying po yi ni snying por bcas// bzhi pas bkab cing khro bas 'joms// dran pa lnga bral srid las grol// chags dang rmongs dbang de nyid mkhyen// de nyid sbyor ba gzir ba'i gtso// zhabs mchog lha yis phyag bgyis pa// padma'i gdan bzhugs gtso bo ni// yongs su mnyes shing tshim bya'i phyir// brgya byin gyis ni gdugs kyang thogs// gdong bzhi pa yis rnga yab g.yob// seng ge dag ni gsol kas gnas// 'phrog byed rje bo'i mtshan nas sgrog

/'jig rten gsum gyis phyag byas pa'i// rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal gyur cig / yig brgya dang bzod gsol bya/ oṃ/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// sgrub byed sreg bya za ba gshegs// ji bzhin dus su tshur byon la// zhi dang bkra shis phun tshogs mdzod// agnā ye badzra muḥ zhes pas gshegs/ de nas tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dpa' bo dpa' mo grangs mnyam lha gnas su lhan cig bkod/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' la sogs pa'i lhar bskyed/ mchod yon zhabs bkru nyer mchod lngas mchod tshogs byin brlabs spyan drangs phud 'bul sogs byas/ chang gi thod pa/ gzigs shig mdzes pa 'di yi chos// sogs kyis thams cad la 'bul/ bde gshegs chos la sdig med cing*// zhes sogs kyis blang*/ ā li mchod pa'i sngags rgya gnas gsum du thig gtor byas nas myang*/ de nas lcags kyu lnga sogs bza' ba la longs spyod/ bud med kyi 'dod pa lnga yul dang rtses pa'i mthar/ rdo rje gsor dril bu 'khrol bas/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ thar pa'i bde ba dam pa'i mchog /snying rjes brgyan pa'i bde la rol// chags pa'i dga' bas brgyan pa yi// drag pos dga' ba 'joms par mdzad// stong pa nyid du gzims pa yis// bza' dang bza' min rnam par spangs// 'gro ba yongs su bsgral ba yis// 'jigs pa'i gzugs kyis rnam par rol// zhes glusanye bar bsdu/ lhag ma lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhin du btang ngo*// de nas dam tshig gso ba'i yan lag tu bdag 'jug len pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ āḥswā hā/ lan bdun bzlas pa'i dam tshig gi chus bsangs/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la// rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi// thams cad theg pa gsum la yang*// sbyor ba gsang ba mkha' 'gro dang*// dpa' bo dpa' mo dpal lha mo// khyad par du yang slob dpon la// rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi'o// bdag la dgongs shig thams cad kyi// rnam snang mi bskyod rin chen mchog

/snang ba mtha' yas don yod sogs// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// dus 'di nas ni bzung nas su// byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad ltar// byang chub sems ni bla na med// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i byang chub sems// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyi nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing*// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces sdom pa byin/ mig gos kyis bkab/ oṃ āḥkhaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ gis me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyor du bcug nas maṇḍal phul/ de ring 'khor ba las bsgral nas// byang chub sems su smon par bya// zhes brjod/ de nas slob mas rang bzhin gyi dag pa sogs bsgom par bya ste/ oṃ swa bhā wa shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ badzra shuddhāḥsarba dharmāḥbadzra shuddho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shuddhāḥsarba dhārmā yo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes pa gsum gyis so// de nas bla mas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// gzhan gyi nor la reg bya min// 'jigs pa kun gyis 'jigs mi bya// sems can byams dang snying rje sogs// bsgom pa dang ni tshul khrims bsrungs// zhes brjod/ oṃ pañtsa ḍā ki nī pū dzo pasthā nā ya ātma nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ oṃ ā tsārya pū dzo pasthā nā ya ātmā nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ oṃ sa ka la sa twa pa ri tra ṇā ya ātmā nāṃ niryā ta yā mi/ ces pas lha rnams la dmigs te phyag bya/

gnas gsum du dris thig le bya/ a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /gsung gi rdo rjer byin gyis brlab// ū ni 'dod pa 'grub byed pa// sku yi rdo rjer byin gyis brlab// haṃ ni nyon mongs sreg byed pa// thugs kyi rdo rjer byin gyis brlab// oṃ dhi li dhi li ma na gur ni da badzra a tsa le yuṃ yuṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas lhag par gnas par bya/ dam la bzhag pa bzhi ste/ deng khyod dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi nang du zhugs kyis/ ngas khyod la dpal he ru ka'i ye shes bskyed par bya ste/ khyod ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor 'di ma mthong ba'i mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ khyod dam tshig nyams par gyur ta re/ rdo rje snying gar bzung la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ snying la yang dag zhugs par mdzad// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /dri yi dung chos sbyin la/ de ring ye shes can ye shes// bdud rtsi dag ni myong bar gyis// oṃ durga ti a pa hā ra ya swā hā/ bdud rtsi myang*/ deng nas brtsams te khyod kyi rnal 'byor nam mkha' nga yin gyis/ ngas gang byos shig bya ba de khyod kyis bya dgos so// khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa'i las ma byed cig /khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par tshe'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes bka' bsgo/ de nas slob ma rdo rje sems dpa' bsgoms pa'i snying gar rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ rkang par yang rlung gi sa bon/ rkang pa'i rlung gi sa bon g.yos pas snying ga'i rlung bskyod/ des ye shes kyi sa bon sbar bar bsam/ slob dpon rdo rje mkha' 'gro mar bsams nas drag po'i hūm̐ bzlas pas/ oṃ ā khi le le hūm̐ a/ rol mo dang sngar bshad pa'i spos kyis bdug

/ches na rnal 'byor pa de lha'i nga rgyal gyis glu gar byed par 'gyur la/ de nas/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra sa ma ya pra ti pā la ka hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swā hā sa gshegs su gsol/ de nas tshom bu lnga lha mo lngar bsgoms nas/ yang dag pa yi dkyil 'khor 'dir// bdag gis slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams ji ltar de bzhin shog /pra titstsha badzra hoḥ zhes gar dang bcas pas dor/ gang la phog pa de khyod kyi rigs kyi lha'o// de nas lha de nyid kyis me tog gi 'phreng ba de mgo bor bcing bar mos te/ sems dpa' stobs chen khyod kyis ni// 'di ni rab tu bzung bar bgyi// zhes pas so// dngos su bla mas bcings/ de nas/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong bar 'gyur// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ dzñā na tsakṣu hūm̐ a swā hā/ zhes pas mig dar phye/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs te// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlab// 'gro ba phun tshogs dngos grub kyang*// thams cad 'di la mngon du 'gyur// dngos grub thob phyir dam tshig skyong*// gsang sngags la yang brtson par gyis// zhes dang*/ sum cu pa yi 'byung ba'i gnas// lha rnams kun gyi bdag po ste// ye shes mkha' 'gro ma dngos kyi// shes rab pha rol phyin mas 'khyud// rnal 'byor nam mkha' zhes bya ba// rnam dag ye shes kyis sprul ltos// me long ye shes las byung ba// sdang ba thams cad 'joms mdzad cing*// glang po'i steng na yang dag bzhugs// shar gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'o// mnyam nyid ye shes las byung ba'i// sbrul dgra yi ni stan la bzhugs// bdud rnams thams cad sreg byed pa// byang gi mkha' 'gro drag mo ltos// mi dge bcu yi las la sogs// rnam par spyod las nges grol ba// bya khyung gi ni stan la bzhugs// nub phyogs ro langs ma la ltos// bya ba kun byed las byung ba// seng ge 'phrog byed 'dul mdzad ma// nyon mongs thams cad sreg pa yi// lho phyogs gtum mo la yang ltos// stag seng 'ug pa ce spyang ste// snying po grwa bzhi dag na gnas// seng ge phag dang ma he dang*// ce spyang gi ni stan la bzhugs// sems can don bya'i rgyu ru ni// thabs chen sna tshogs gzugs kyis bzhugs// mkha' 'gro me 'bar 'jigs byed ma// 'phrog byed ma ste sgo rnams skyong*// lha rnams thams cad 'gugs pa dang*// 'dzud cing 'ching dang mnyes byed yin// spos mo 'ju byed gtum mo ste// bdud rtsi'i snod ni phyag na bsnams// drag mo khrag gsol sha gsol ma// lcags kyu lnga yis bkang ba yi// padma'i snod ni bsnams nas su// gcig gi steng nas 'gebs par mdzad// drag shul 'bar ma mi sdug ma// phyag na 'dam skyes gtor mas bkang*// thod pa ma dang rdo rje ma// bum can bza' btung bsnams shing 'gebs// sgeg mo dri dang pi wang dang*// me tog glu dang bdug par bcas// gar dang mar mer bcas pa kun// phyogs mtshams mchod par brtson pa yin/

dkyus su ma gsal yang mdor bsags ltar te/ /keng rus 'jigs byed pa la sogs/ sems dpa' yab yum nyi shu ni// phyogs su gsum dang mtshams su gnyis// lha snam ser po'i steng du gnas/ 1$0000250/ces 'byung*/ khyab 'jug dag ni gsol ka ste// tshangs pa rnga ma thogs shing g.yob// drag po ming ni sgrog par byed// brgya byin gdugs ni thogs te gnas// rang gi chung ma sder bcas pa// phyi rol sgo bzhi dag na gnas// dbang po nor lha 'byung po'i bdag /chu yi rgyal po mtshams bzhi na// rang gi chung ma sder bcas pa// sna tshogs mchod pa thogs shing gnas// bar snang gnas pa'i grong khyer gyis// lha yi de nyid mtshon par bya// 'jug pa'o// de nas slob mas bla mar phyag dang*/ arghaṃ la sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod lnga dang bcas pas mchod de/ rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs bcas pa// rdo rje nam mkha'i go 'phang las// phyir mi ldog par bdag 'gyur ba'i// rig pa gang yin deng bdag gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ slob mas thal mo sbyar/ oṃ rdo rje dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so// oṃ sbyor ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong*// oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ sa ma ya st+waṃ/ sa ma ya hoḥs ma ya hoḥ slob ma zhes pa don dam smra ba'i seng ge yis// nyon mongs srid pa'i nyes pa skye ba'i sa gzhom phyir// rnal 'byor cho gas nyon mongs g.yos pa gcod pa'i phyir// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po nyid du 'grub gyur cig / slob dpon gyis lag g.yas rdo rje khu tshur las mthe bong srin lag sbyar ba rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i phyag rgyas gnas brgyad du reg cing*/ spyi bor kṣuṃ/ mig gnyis la hūm̐/ rna ba gnyis dang sna la yuṃ/ lce la suṃ/ mgrin par saṃmarayu/ dpung pa gnyis la haṃmarayu/

snying gar yaṃmarayu/ lte bar kṣaṃmarayu/ dgod/ drag mo mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i bdag nyid do// slob mas/ sngags kyi tshul gyi de kho na nyid du bya ste smon lam gdab pa ni/ oṃ sa ma yā haṃ/ mi ti maṃ/ oṃ badzro haṃ/ ma ti pa/ oṃ danyano haṃ/ mi ti hūm̐/ oṃ warta mā no haṃ hoḥ oṃ udbha ba a aṃ a aṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes de nyid so sor bzung bas/ rnal 'byor nam mkha' ye shes kyi sku ni bdag go// zhes nga rgyal gzung*/ de nas slob ma seng ge'i gdan/ steng du gdugs phub par bzang po'i 'dug stangs kyis shar du kha bltas/ lag pa gnyis me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar ba/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rnal 'byor nam mkha' thob par bya'o// snyam pa'i blo dang ldan par byas te/ bsang sbyangs/ slob ma mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur pa'i ngang las/ skad cig gis mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad cing*/ yum chen rnams kyis bdud rtsi'i bum pas dbang bskur/ dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis bkra shis kyi glu dang*/ me tog gi char 'bebs bzhin pas mngon par dbang bskur bar bsam la/ slob dpon gyis dbus la sogs pa'i bum pa rtsa ba'i sngags/

oṃ yo ga aṃ wa ra dṛṣya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa ma yā st+waṃ/ sa ma yā hoḥ bzlas shing rol mo dang bcas pas/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba// sdug bsngal gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa// srid pa'i nyes dmigs bskyed pa nyon mongs bcom nas ni// rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid 'grub gyur cig / ces bkra shis kyi glu len cing slob dpon kha nub tu bltas pas dbang bskur te/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po ni// khams gsum= /sangs rgyas= /gnas las= /de ring 'khor ba sgrol byed pa'i// byang chub chen por dbang bskur ro// oṃ āḥphruṃ pheṃ phaṭ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes chu blug ste khrus bya'o/ /de ltar chu yi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa zhe sdang dag kun gzhi'i rnam shes gnas 'gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du gyur pa yin no// de nas mdzub mo gnyis sbrel bas/ oṃ badzra kā ya hūm̐ a swā hā/ zhes pas slob ma'i gnas brgyad bsrung zhing bcing bar gyur par mos/ de nas dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur ba la/ bsang sbyangs/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum chen rnams kyis sangs rgyas rnam lnga'i bdag nyid can gyi cod pan gyis mngon par dbang bskur bar mos la/ thor tsugs cod pan gyis brgyan pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi bsngags pa yi// rin chen dag gi dbu rgyan dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /zhes dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur ba'am/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis bcings nas mdzub mo gnyis bsgreng rtse mo cung zad bkug pa sprad nas gung mo gnyis brkyang*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes phyag rgyas reg cing*/ sngags kyis dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur/ de ltar cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa ser sna dag nyon mongs pa can gyi yid gnas 'gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// de nas rdo rje'i dbang bskur ba la/ bsang sbyangs/ slob ma rnams skad cig gis snang ba mtha' yas dmar po padma dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum gos dkar mo dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ dkyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad cing*/ yum chen rnams kyis rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad pas/ dbang bskur bar mos la/ sangs rgyas rnal 'byor nam mkha' yi// dbang gis de ring khyod dbang bskur// sangs rgyas kun gyis rab grub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyed kyis longs// oṃ shrī yo ga aṃ bha ri twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ bhi ra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes lag pa g.yas su rdo rje gtad/ de thugs kar gsor ba'i tshul du 'dzin cing*/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag / ces brjod/ de ltar rdo rje'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa 'dod chags dag /yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnas 'gyur/ so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// rdo rje'i dbang ngo*// de nas dril bu'i dbang bskur ba ni/ bsang sbyangs/ slob ma skad cig gis don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang khu gri thod 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ dkyil mo dkrung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad cing*/

yum chen rnams kyis dril bu lag pa g.yon du gtad pas dbang bskur bar bsam la/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bshad// dril bu dkrol bzhin/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis dngos med byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' ni// srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /dril bu g.yon du gtad cing dkur brten/ de ltar dril bu'i dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa phrag dog dag sgo lnga'i rnam par shes pa gnas 'gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// dril bu'i dbang ngo*// de nas ming gi dbang bskur ba ni/ bsang sbyangs/ slob ma skad cig gis rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum spyan ma dkar mo gri thod 'dzin mas 'khyud pa/ gnyis ka'ang dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa gsal bar gyur/ bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bos dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad cing*/ yum chen rnams kyis ming gi dbang bskur bar mos la/ oṃ shrī yo ga aṃ ba ri twaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi/ nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kyai dpal gyi mthar rigs dang mthun pa'i ming btags/ de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas nyon mongs pa gti mug dag /gzugs kyi phung po gnas 'gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes pa yin no// ming dbang ngo*/ /de dag slob bu'i dbang ngo*/ de nas rdo rje dril bu 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas nas/ rdo rje dril bu 'khyud nas ni// g.yon snyems pa dang sgros gnon 'chang*// gnyis med gnyis med rnal 'byor gyis// phyag rgya chen por byin gyis rlobs// sangs rgyas kun bdag rnal 'byor ldan/ /ces brjod/ de nas ā li kā li'i sngags 'phreng slob dpon gyi zhal nas phyung*/

slob ma lhar gsal ba'i zhal nas zhugs par bsam zhing dbyangs dang gsal byed lan gsum zlos su bcug pa sngags dbang ngo*// de nas rdo rje lag pa g.yas su gtad de/ 'di ste sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bcang*// rnal 'byor nam mkha'i brtul zhugs bstan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha e ṣa st+waṃ dhā ra ya mi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ha ha ha hoḥ / brtul zhugs kyi dbang ngo*/ /deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang*// shes rab thabs kyi snyem chen gyis// gar mchod bde ba'i dga' ston gyis// āḥ zhes sgeg pa dang*/ sgeg dang bcas par 'phreng ba 'chang*// sangs rgyas kun dngos rnal 'byor ma// de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur te// 'phreng ba 'di ni rgyan yin no// oṃ zhes 'phreng ba/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blang bar gyis// des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang*// myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur// gī zhes glu/ de nyid thal mo gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas thams cad chags par byed// sangs rgyas 'dul ba'i 'phrin las ni// gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis// hoḥ zhes gar/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pas// mtshan dang dpe byad brgyan pa yi// bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis// bhrum̐/ zhes me tog /rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim pa// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis// hūm̐ zhes spos/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas// padma gar dbang rang nyid ni// sems can ma lus ldongs pa la// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis// pra zhes mar me/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas// tshul khrims shes rab ting 'dzin dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams la bgo// gha

zhes dri sbyin/ zhes sgeg sogs brgyad gar gyi dbang ngo*/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ oṃ badzra ni tra ya a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥ thur ma'i dbang ngo*/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo med cing gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang rnal 'byor ma sras skyes// zhes pas me long gi dbang ngo*/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// 'jig rten khams ni thams cad du// bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi// chos kyi 'khor lo skor bar gyis// 'khor lo'i dbang ngo*/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// dung gi dbang ngo*// g.yon chos gos kyi sna ri dwags kyi rna ba 'dra bar dang*/ g.yas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas/ slob dpon ye shes mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gzung zhing dkyil 'khor chen po'i lha tshogs dang mgrin gcig tu lung ston par bya ste/ 'dir ni ngas khyod lung bstan yin// rnal 'byor nam mkha' de bzhin gshegs// ngan 'gro'i srid las bton nas su// srid mchog gtan du dag par gyis// he shrī yo ga bhā rī nā ma ta thā ga ta sid dhya sa ma ya st+waṃ bhur bhuḥbaḥswaḥ lung bstan no/ /de dag slob dpon gyi dbang ste bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas maṇḍal phul/ yon tan rgya mtsho khyed mthu yis// de nyid bla med shes par 'tshal// rdo rje'i dbang bskur kun mkhyen gyi// bka' drin de ring bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas kun la gsang ba che// ji ltar dpal ldan rdo rje sems// rdo rje chos ni brtan pa bzhin// mgon pos bdag la bka' drin mnos// bcom ldan khyod zhabs padma ni// spangs nas gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'khor ba'i 'gro ba spang ba'i phyir// de bas mgon pos brtse bar mdzod//

lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i mig bkab/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang dbyer med pa'i rnal 'byor nam mkha'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la slob mas phul ba'i phyag rgya shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i lha mo dang gnyis su med pa snyoms par zhugs pas sangs rgyas lnga'i rang bzhin gyi sa bon kunda lta bu phyag rgya'i skye gnas kyi me tog dmar po'i nang du rol ba chags pa dang*/ chags bral dang*/ de gnyis 'dres pa ste sde tshan gsum gyis sprul pa rdo rje dang padma nas lces len du stsal te/ de dus 'di skad brjod par bya'o/ /dpa' bo sdig gi gnyen po ste// dpal dang ldan zhing lhun che ba// dpa' bor de nyid goms par bya// sangs rgyas kun bdag sbyor ba yin// de nas sgrub thabs kyi sngags rgya/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes pas spyi bor rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po byang chub mchog /dpral bar mi bskyod pa sngon po sa gnon/ rna ltag g.yas su rin chen 'byung ldan ser po mchog sbyin/ ltag par snang ba mtha' yas dmar po ting nge 'dzin/ rna ltag g.yon du don yod grub pa ljang khu skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing mdzes pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas bklubs pa'o// ces gnas lngar rigs lnga bskyed/ oṃ ṭuṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes go cha bskon/ mig dar bkrol lo// gsang dbang ngo*// de nas sngar bzhin maṇḍal/ bcom ldan khyod zhabs padma ni// spangs nas gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'khor ba'i 'gro ba spang ba'i phyir// de bas mgon pos brtse bar mdzod// ces gsol ba btab/ slob ma'i gdong g.yogs/ gnyis med sbyor ba de nyid ni// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// so sor de nyid kyis bzung ba// rdo rje de nyid bdag nyid de// dril bu chos kyi gzungs ma'o// phyag rgya kha sbyor tshul gyis ni// de la thabs ni thim par 'gyur//

zhes slob ma la phyag rgya gtad/ de nyid slob ma bcom ldan 'das rnal 'byor nam mkha' dang*/ shes rab ma ye shes dbang phyug yab yum du gsal bas snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bu dang bya gdong kha sbyor ba'i rtser phab ste gnyis mnyam las kun rdzob thams cad don dam pa zag pa med pa'i ye shes su thim pa rtogs par bya'o// zag pa med pa'i ye shes de nyid kun gzhi rnam par shes pa 'jug shes su ma 'thor bar bstan pa las rnyed pa'i phyir/ ye shes rnam shes bstan par bya// zhes gsungs so// gdong g.yogs phye/ sngar bzhin maṇḍal/ bcom ldan khyod zhabs padma ni// spangs nas gzhan la skyabs ma mchis// 'khor ba'i 'gro ba spang ba'i phyir// de bas mgon pos brtse bar mdzod// ces gsol btab byas/ dbang gsum pa'i dus su rtogs pa'i don dam zag pa med pa'i ye shes de nyid// pha dang ma ni bsad bya dang*// rgyal po gtsang sbra bram ze dang*// yul phyogs rgyu ba bsad pa ni// mi de dag pa'i ming zhes bya// zhes dang*/ gnyis dang gnyis med rab spangs pa// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mi bzad pa'i// chu bo'i dgra las grol ba yi// mtshon bya mtshon pa'i mtshan nyid rnams// rnam shes ye shes gnyis bstan bya// zhes pas gtan la phab ste gsal bar bya'o// de nas/ gsang chen de dag thams cad kyi// dbang bskur ba ni go 'phang mchog /bzod pa'i chos ni sngon 'gro bas// sems can rnams ni gzir mi bya// tshig rtsub 'khyal ba smra min zhing*// sems can rnams ni sun mi dbyung*// tshul khrims sdom pa bsrung bya zhing*// skye bo rnams la gtse mi bya// bdag nyid shi bar gyur kyang bla'i// sems can srog gcod de lta min// rab tu 'bar mer mtshungs pas na// gzhan gyi nor la reg mi bya// rnal 'byor pa yis brdzun bsrung zhing*// phan tshun dbye ba'i las mi bya// rnal 'byor spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// de la rdzun ni yod ma yin// spyod pa bag yod bcas pa dang*// bza' dang longs spyod bag yod bya// dga' bar rol ba bag yod cing*// gtor tshogs cho ga bag yod bya// rnal 'byor ma yi grub 'dod pas// sems can bsten na 'grub par 'gyur// thams cad shes pa'i slob ma gang*// sems can dga' ba'i las rnams bya// mnyam nyid ye shes las bskyed nas// thams cad mnyam nyid blta bar bya// rtag tu mnyam pa'i spyod pa can// rtag tu rnal 'byor bsam gtan dgus// bslab pa blangs pa sngon 'gro bas// dkyil 'khor gtor ma la sogs pa// sems can don bya'i tshul khrims rnams// bu yis srog bzhin bskyang bar bya//

ces gdams/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa// de ltar bdag gis bgyid par 'tshal// de nas lha la phyag 'tshal du bcug /de nas bla ma la gtang rag gi maṇḍal dang*/ lus longs spyod sogs yon phul/ mchod pa gsar du bshams/ oṃ saṃ shwa dha na hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ ha ho hrīḥ sa byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ pra tītstsha arghaṃ hūm̐ swā hā/

mchod yon/ oṃ pra wa rā satka ra pra tītstsha hūm̐ swā hā/ zhabs bsil/ oṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ dri chab/ oṃ shrīṃ swā hā/ me tog oṃ iṃ swā hā/ bdug spos/ oṃ kṣuṃ swā hā/ snang gsal/ oṃ i swā hā/ zhal zas rnams kyi mchod pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu bzung nas/ hūm̐ hūm̐/ mgon khyod yongs su thar pa'ang khyod// chos ston pa yang khyod yin te// snying rje'i rgyu las byung ba'i gzugs// kye'i gzugs bzang thar pa khyod// kye'i de nyid srid pa las grol khyod// rdo rje khyed la phyag 'tshal 'dud// kye thar pa'i rdo rje'ang khyod nyid do// zhes bstod/ sgrub mchod kyi nyin phyi mar mchod pa rnams la tshig bcad bcas dang*/ mchod pa nyi shu rgyas bsdus gang 'os/ sems dpa' chen po dang po'i mchog / sogs kyis bstod pa bya/ tshogs la rol/ lhag ma bsngos te/ oṃ ra ma ra mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐ ho āḥ.oṃ ra ma ra ma ho hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho āḥ.oṃ ra ma ra ma phruṃ phuṃ phuṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ āḥ.oṃ ra ma ra ma ho ghu ghu ghuṃ gho a swā hā/ rnal 'byor ma brgyad kyi 'phreng sngags kyis mnyes par byas la thal mo sbyar/ me tog gis snyim pa bkang*/ sems can thams cad la sems chen pos/ sems can thams cad nad med cing*// sems can thams cad bde gyur te// gang gi lam gnas 'gro ba yis// sangs rgyas nyid du 'grub gyur cig /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral// ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol// da ltar rjes su brtse ba'i phyir// rnal 'byor gtsug lag bdag bgyis so// ces smon lam btab/ nyin phyi mar yon bdag dang sems can thams cad la dung chos kyi chus bkrus/ de ring khyod ni 'khor ba yi// rgya mtsho las ni rab brgal zhing*// rdo rje las byung rdo rje dngos// sangs rgyas go 'phang dbang bskur zhing*// myur du sems can thams cad kyi// don byed nus pa'i sems dang ldan//

zhes shis pa byas/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar/ /oṃ na maste hūm̐/ na mo mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes lus ngag yid kyis phyag bya/ oṃ/ bdag gi cho ga ma tshang rnams// bcom ldan 'das la bzod par gsol// zhes dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ rdo rje khu tshur g.yon pa snying gar bca'/ g.yas pa brkyang nas sa la btsugs te/ oṃ/ ji ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// sems can phan par mdzad pa dang*// sangs rgyas yul du byon nas kyang*// slar yang 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ gatstsha gatstsha swā hā/ swa bhā wā nāṃ hūm̐ swā hā/ ye shes 'jig rten las 'das pa dang*/ oṃ gatstsha su ra ṇa ga ma ra ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ se gol lan gsum gtogs pas/ 'jig rten pa rnams gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rnams rang gi dbugs dang lhan cig nang du bsdus te/ ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i lha mo ni spyi bo mig rna ba sna lcer/ seng ge ma sogs mgrin dpung snying lte ba/ sgo bsrung bzhi ni g.yas dang g.yon gyi brla dang rje ngar gnyis su/ pukka sī sogs lce/ drag mo sogs brang*/ gtum mo sogs kha/ thod 'phreng ma sogs lcer/ sgeg sogs brgyad snying nu bar mgrin pa/ mgo bo so gsang ba/ dpung pa/ mig la yi ge'i rnam par/ keng rus 'jigs byed sogs sems dpa' bcu drug dbugs dang 'od zer/ 'jig rten pa'i lha chen brgyad ba spu'i khung dang rkang sogs la rim pa bzhin du yi ge'i gzugs su 'khod par gyur/ ba dan gsum pa'i phyag rgyas 'god par bya'o/ /rang nyid rnal 'byor nam mkhar gsal ba'i spyi bor kṣuṃ/ mig gnyis la hūm̐/ rna ba gnyis dang sna la yuṃ/ lce la suṃ/ mgrin par saṃmarayu/ dpung pa gnyis la haṃmarayu/ snying gar yaṃmarayu/ lte bar kṣaṃmarayu rnams drag mo mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa'i bdag nyid do// oṃ badzra kā ya hoḥ oṃ badzra wākkā āḥ oṃ badzra tsitta hūm̐/

zhes rgyas btab/ oṃ hūm̐ āḥswā hā/ zhes pas dbang bskur/ oṃ ṭuṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes pas gnas bsrung*/ oṃ dzñā na ḍā ki ni sa ma ya sogs yi ge brgya pas brtan par bya/ oṃ gi li gi li na da ma hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ tshon rnams phyags la chu bo chen por bskyal/ oṃ hi li hi li phu li ma hā phu li pheṃ pheṃ swā hā/ lhag ma'i gtor ma bzhi mdo'am/ chu 'gram du bskyal lo/ rdul tshon gshegs rjes slar ldog nas slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi shul der rdul tshon ser pos padma 'dab brgyad lte ba ge sar dang bcas pa bris pa'i mdun du/ gtor ma dang mchod pa bshams la/ sgrub thabs ltar/ padma'i lte bar seng ge'i khri sogs kyis lha dgu dang sgo ma'i bar bskyed/ spyan 'dren mchod bstod/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gtang ba man chad dang*/ gshegs gsol sogs sgrub thabs ltar la/ bkra shis rgyas par brjod/ mchod pa thams cad kyis gsang ba'i 'khor lo mchod cing*/ slob mar bcas pas glu gar rnal 'byor ma rnams lhan cig bde ba la chags par bya'o// nub mtha' ma'i cho ga'o// de ltar gdan bzhi'i cho ga ārya de wa'i zhabs dang*/ rnam rgyal dbang po'i sdes mdzad pa ltar/ rje btsun mar rngog gi bka' drin chen pos 'tsho ba/ padma dkar pos/ nyang stod rtse chen gyi pho brang chen por sbyar ba'i dge bas thams cad kyang rdo rje 'chang gi sa la myur ba nyid du chas par gyur cig /gang yang grub pa'i shing rta yis// srol phye de nas ma 'khyogs par// 'dod pa'i dngos grub sar bgrod pa// blo gsal padma dkar po'i lugs/ slad nas dbang bskur dang sgrub mchod sogs la 'jug pa bde bar byos shig ces mchog gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bka' stsal yang yang gnang ba spyi bor mchod nas ngag dbang mthu stobs tshul khrims bstan 'dzin rgyas mtshos khungs ldan gyi yig cha rnams la sgo bstun te spyi brtol bskyed nas bklag chog tu bkod pa 'dir tshul bzhin ma rtogs log rtog kyi nongs pa mtha' dag bla ma lhag pa'i lha yi spyan sngar snying nas 'chags shing*/
